description:
Opportunity

Account Directors produce high quality advisory documents demonstrating a deep understanding of clients and issues. You will be regularly providing advice and analysis to clients, and developing an advisory voice informed by research, experience and awareness of market trends and events. You will manage some key workstreams as well as guiding executives and assistants on the account.

As an Account Director, you will also begin to develop a network and build relationships with clients, media, advisers, Brunswick colleagues and other stakeholders. You will work to develop your media-handling skills and have a good understanding of Brunswick’s different sectors and specialist offers and how to connect them with clients as part of our one firm offering.

About the Role

This role is working within Brunswick’s expanding Defence Sector Group, focussing on Investor Relations and capital market communications. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver media, political, regulatory and market analysis to clients, with intelligent insight and recommendations informed by data, analysis and experience.
  • Manage the development of high-quality client documents, playing a key role in drafting, proofing, editing and version control, along with seamless project management of client workstreams.
  • Guide executives and assistants in effectively supporting accounts.
  • Work to develop a solid understanding of different sectors and specialist offers.
  • Ensure all logistics for client meetings and events are executed smoothly and manage upwards to ensure Brunswick delivers on time and above expectation.
  • Begin to develop an advisory voice informed by research, experience and awareness of market trends and events.
  • Nurture a network amongst peers inside and outside the firm, providing valuable insight for the firm and for clients.

What We’re Looking For

  • Highly knowledgeable on business issues and current affairs; up to date on key trends, issues, commentators and debates, particularly as it relates to the investor community.
  • 2-5 years’ experience ideally working in the German aerospace and defence sectors as well as in relevant policy areas – with the potential to further expand it.
  • Experience in report writing (English/German), presentation preparation, stakeholder analysis and social media.
  • Able to demonstrate excellent written research and analysis for business audiences; must be able to synthesize large amounts of intelligence across numerous sources in a timely but thoughtful manner.
  • Proven project and/or program management experience, with the ability to oversee multiple fast-moving workstreams at any one time.
  • A dynamic self-starter with a strong work ethic.
  • High level of attention to detail and an intellectually rigorous, client-service attitude.
  • An experienced team-worker who prefers to work in a collegiate way.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

Brunswick is committed to transparent and equitable pay practices. Information regarding the salary range and overall compensation package for this role will be made available to candidates during the recruitment process and may be requested at any stage prior to interview.

 

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

description: Dit is Shiftbase Meer dan 10.000 bedrijven. Ruim 250.000 gebruikers. Eén missie: personeelsplanning en tijdregistratie simpel maken. Ons platform is gebouwd om makkelijk, flexibel en schaalbaar te zijn, of je klant nu 15 of 2500 medewerkers heeft. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn. Wat ga je doen? Als Account Executive voor de Nederlandse markt ben jij de persoon die kansen omzet in betalende klanten. Je bedient de B2B-markt over de volle breedte: van horeca tot retail, van zorg tot transport. Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort. Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Onze marketing levert continu leads aan van bedrijven die actief op zoek zijn, en dat gaat hard. Maar we willen niet afhankelijk zijn van alleen wat er binnenkomt. Je krijgt de ruimte, en de verwachting, om zelf ook kansen te creëren in accounts die je interessant vindt. Hoe we dat als team het beste aanpakken, bepalen we samen. Jouw ervaring in de praktijk weegt daarin mee. Het volledige sales process is van jou, van discovery en demo tot onderhandeling en close. Na de close draag je het account over aan ons Customer Success-team. Jij focust volledig op new business. Je werkt met tempo en volume, en je weet wanneer een deal aandacht verdient en wanneer je hem moet laten gaan. Je dag bestaat voor een groot deel uit bellen en demo's, want dit is een hands-on salesrol. Sporadisch ga je op pad naar een klant voor een persoonlijk gesprek. Je bouwt mee aan een groeiend salesteam binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie, en dat vraagt energie, initiatief en doorzettingsvermogen. Je deelt wat voor jou werkt met het team, want we worden hier beter van elkaar. Wie ben jij? Een salesprofessional met een paar jaar ervaring die energie krijgt van tempo, van veel gesprekken en van scoren. Je hebt bewezen dat je kunt presteren in een snelle SaaS-salesomgeving en je wilt nu een volgende stap zetten in een team dat hard aan het opbouwen is. Je wacht niet tot de telefoon gaat: als je een account in gedachten hebt, vind je zelf een weg naar binnen. Verder herkennen we je aan het volgende: je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in high-velocity software sales (SaaS), je bent commercieel scherp zonder je klant uit het oog te verliezen, je bent leergierig en staat open voor coaching, en je beheerst Nederlands uitstekend. Engels is een pre. Profielen die ons aanspreken: je komt uit de SaaS-wereld en hebt ervaring met snelle funnels en hoge volumes. Denk aan omgevingen zoals Lightspeed, Zenchef of vergelijkbare SME-gerichte hospitality- of retailtech. Of je hebt een leidinggevende achtergrond in de horeca, bent tech-savvy en hebt slimme techoplossingen geïmplementeerd in die rol, en je wilt nu de overstap maken naar software sales aan onder andere de horeca. In beide gevallen: je snapt de wereld van onze klanten als geen ander. Wat bieden wij jou? Een rol waarin je een SaaS-oplossing verkoopt die bedrijven écht vooruit helpt, in een omgeving waar resultaat en plezier hand in hand gaan. Groei is hier geen loze belofte. We investeren serieus in je ontwikkeling vanaf dag één. Je start met een gedegen 30-60-90-dagen-onboardingprogramma met duidelijke milestones, zodat je precies weet waar je staat en waar je naartoe werkt. Je wordt daarnaast getraind en gecertificeerd via Winning by Design, hét toonaangevende salestrainingsprogramma voor SaaS, inclusief SPICED-certificering. Daarbovenop krijg je een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar om te investeren in wat jou verder brengt: cursussen, conferenties, boeken of coaching. Jij kiest. Verder bieden we een brutojaarsalaris van €55.000 tot €75.000 inclusief vakantiegeld op basis van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Daarnaast 25 vakantiedagen, een flexibele regeling voor thuis en op kantoor werken, een goede pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding (NS Business Card of kilometervergoeding). De werksfeer? Ontspannen, met gratis lunch, bootcamp op donderdag, vrijdagmiddagborrels en kwartaal-BBQ's. Hoe werken we samen? De eerste 3 maanden verwachten we een hogere aanwezigheid op kantoor in Zoetermeer. Logisch: je wilt het team, het product en de klant snel doorgronden, en dat gaat nu eenmaal sneller als je er bent. Na je onboarding werken we meer hybride. Woon je op maximaal anderhalf uur reisafstand? Dan verwachten we je minimaal één keer per week op kantoor, op dinsdag of donderdag. In de praktijk gaan we hier flexibel mee om zodra het vertrouwen er is. Woon je dichterbij of heb je geen probleem met wat meer reistijd? Elke dag op kantoor is natuurlijk ook gewoon mogelijk. Daarnaast is er de hub in Amsterdam waar je terecht kunt. Waarom Shiftbase? Je verkoopt geen vaag platform dat niemand begrijpt. Shiftbase is marktleider in Nederland en groeit hard in Duitsland. Een product dat 10.000+ bedrijven dagelijks gebruiken omdat het hun werk simpelweg makkelijker maakt. Dat merk je in elk salesgesprek: klanten snappen de waarde, de use case is herkenbaar en de feedback is positief. Tegelijkertijd zijn we geen logge olietanker. Met 85+ collega's ben je geen nummer, want wat jij doet heeft directe impact op de koers van het bedrijf. Maar we zijn wél groot en stabiel genoeg om je een serieuze carrière te bieden. Geen start-up-roulette, maar een bewezen business met internationale groeiambities waar jij onderdeel van wordt. Interesse? description: Let’s transform banking forever ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate. But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward. What you can expect: ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank. Your mission: As an Account Lead in our Mid-Market Client Management team focused on Client Success, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining strong, trusted relationships with a portfolio of existing and new clients. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our clients’ businesses, priorities and evolving needs, helping them get the most from their relationship with ClearBank while ensuring we continue to deliver positive client outcomes. Skills & Experience (must-have) · Strong knowledge and practical experience of the payments industry is essential, with the credibility to discuss payments propositions, client requirements and relevant industry developments with senior client stakeholders. · Proven experience managing and developing existing B2B client relationships, ideally within payments, banking or financial services. · Demonstrable experience of building trusted, long-term relationships with clients, understanding their objectives and using that insight to improve client outcomes. · A track record of identifying and successfully progressing upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client relationships. · Strong commercial skills, with the ability to balance client success, relationship retention and account growth. · Experience conducting structured client and account reviews and translating client needs into clear actions and opportunities. · Proven stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility with decision makers and senior stakeholders within client organisations. · Great communication, questioning and presentation skills, including the ability to make complex payments and banking topics clear and relevant for different audiences. · Problem-solving and judgement, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders and maintain client confidence when navigating issues or competing priorities. · Ability to work collaboratively across multiple internal teams to deliver positive outcomes for clients. Nice-to-have · Broader knowledge of banking infrastructure and embedded banking. · Experience working with fintech, financial services or other regulated organisations. · Experience managing complex client relationships involving multiple products and stakeholder groups. What success looks like in the role · Clients experience a proactive, trusted and value-adding relationship with ClearBank, supported by a strong understanding of their business and priorities. · Client relationships are maintained and developed effectively, with risks, issues and changing client needs identified and addressed proactively. · Appropriate cross-sell and upsell opportunities are identified and progressed based on genuine client needs and commercial value. · Account plans and client information remain current, providing a clear view of relationship health, priorities, opportunities and agreed actions. · Strong collaboration across ClearBank supports positive client outcomes and sustainable long-term relationships. description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success. What you’ll be doing As an Account Manager, you will: Identify and close opportunities within your book of business to grow accounts through upsells, new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned to evolving customer needs. Build deep relationships with key stakeholders to understand their strategic initiatives, and uncover whitespace opportunities. Use MEDDICC (or similar) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to ensure forecast accuracy and deal velocity. Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows that drive stronger adoption and platform value for upsells. Create custom proposals and business cases that quantify value, align with commercial goals, and support customer budgeting cycles. Work across senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders to land multi-threaded expansions. Lead commercial conversations ensuring terms reflect the value Pleo delivers. Use customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and deepen platform adoption. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC) A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention Complete fluency in English Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need. You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal. You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value. This role is not a good fit for you if: You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue. You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it. You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment. Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap. Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale The location [Delete this for critical/hard to fill role where VISA sponsorship can be an option] Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits! 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role Bar Raiser: A final interview with a senior leader Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. Job responsibilities

Shaping and winning

  • Agentic AI advisory and strategy: shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.

  • Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.

  • Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.

Designing and building

  • Design and build engineering: set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.

  • Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.
  • Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.

Principal-level leadership and growing capability 

  • Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.
  • Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.
  • Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.
  • Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.
  • Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.
  • Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.
  • Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).
  • Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.
  • Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.
  • Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).
  • Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.
  • Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.
  • Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.
  • Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.
  • Strongly preferred: delivering AI in healthcare or life sciences (e.g. R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing quality, commercial).
  • Nice to have: integrating agents with SAP and industrial or manufacturing systems; data product and data platform foundations for AI.

Consulting and Commercial Track Record

  • Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.
  • Strong consulting and commercial judgement: you can point to data and AI (ideally agentic or GenAI) pursuits you helped shape, sell and deliver in the last three to five years, from around €3M–5M upwards, including fixed-price or outcome-linked elements.
  • Experience shaping, solutioning, selling and delivering complex deals of €5M+ in the last few years. Annual target of solutioning, selling and delivering €10M+ TCV in Data & AI deals with an AI-first delivery focus.
  • Comfortable discussing P&L, business cases and ROI with executive buyers, not just architecture.
  • Consultancy or professional-services experience within the last five years, ideally with German, Dutch or DACH enterprise clients.
  • You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset (e.g. a reusable accelerator).

Professional Skills

  • Executive presence and communication skills, making complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, moving fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.
  • Ability to influence across organisations without formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.
  • Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and raise standards across a wider engineering community.
  • Self-directed, prioritisation-led working style, with creative problem-solving in fixed-scope, outcome-driven work.
  • Experience navigating German and Dutch stakeholder structures, including works councils, data protection officers and procurement.
  • German B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred; fluent English. Dutch is a plus for Netherlands-based candidates.

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. Déjà déployé avec succès en France, Espagne, Italie et Belgique, ce projet est le premier d’une série à venir.

Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e "Builder" : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.

Nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer confirmé(e) pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de nos solutions d’IA pour les contrôleurs de gestion. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.

🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES 

  1. Développement Agentique & Fonctionnalités
  • Participer à l'extension des capacités de nos agents vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant notamment des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).

  1. Qualité, Évaluation & Observabilité (LLMOps)
  • Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité de nos pipelines (Databricks / Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine).

  • Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow, Langfuse).

  • Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.
  1. Sécurité, Cloisonnement & Déploiement International
  • Isolation & Multi-tenancy : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de filtrage par métadonnées (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et/ou des modèles) pour assurer une étanchéité parfaite des données entre les différentes sociétés fiscales, entités légales et géographies de Decathlon.

  1. Produit & Impact Business
  • Aider à l'analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l'impact de nos produits

🧠 PROFIL RECHERCHE

Vous justifiez également d'au moins une expérience concrète et réussie de mise en production d'un système GenAI ou agentique.
  • Stack Technique : Solide maîtrise de Python, de l'écosystème GCP / Vertex AI + Databricks, et des frameworks d'orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou Google ADK).
  • Expertise LLM & Agentique : Solide maîtrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avancée de métadonnées), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte/mémoire.
  • Qualité & Évaluation : Capacité à diagnostiquer une réponse incorrecte (problème de modèle, de retrieval ou de données) et appétence pour l'observabilité applicative (SQL / MLflow).
  • Langues : Français courant obligatoire & anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).

Les plus : 

  • Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.
  • Compréhension technique des enjeux de sécurité (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqués aux LLMs.
  • Connaissance des architectures microservices et conception d'APIs.

 

🎁 CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS

  • L'opportunité de développer un produit d'IA agentique de pointe avec un impact direct sur le quotidien des collaborateurs.
  • Un environnement technologique premium (Stack Google Cloud / Vertex AI / Databricks).
  • Une politique de télétravail flexible (2 jours par semaine en remote, le reste dans nos bureaux).

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. description:
About the job

Expose manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s advanced circuit boards with tests you build and deploy.

Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. You’ll take tests from initial design analysis to deployment, then support them in factories and the field.

Better defect coverage means more opportunities to identify manufacturing problems and understand hardware failures when products are in use. You’ll help make test and inspection methods work together, targeting the ways advanced electronic assemblies can go wrong.

You’ll examine PCB testability and susceptibility to manufacturing defects, then use that analysis to define and develop test solutions. You’ll build boundary scan and embedded functional tests, turning your understanding of board behaviour into practical diagnostic tools.

The team and culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team tackles hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. You’ll work directly with Hardware Design, Manufacturing Operations and contract electronics manufacturers, connecting design knowledge with factory experience.

Use evidence to guide test decisions, challenge gaps in coverage and take responsibility for moving improvements forward. Move quickly from diagnosis to action, bringing the right people together to resolve hardware problems.

What we're looking for

  • Strong electronics fundamentals, particularly digital electronics.
  • Commercial experience in board or PCBA hardware testing.
  • Understanding of manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.
  • Knowledge of surface-mount technology (SMT), PCB manufacturing processes and their failure mechanisms.
  • Understanding of automated optical inspection (AOI) and automated X-ray inspection (AXI) capabilities.
  • Ability to diagnose electronic defects to component level.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. 

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. 

Ready to put your board test expertise behind reliable Graphcore hardware? Apply now to join our Bristol team.

Job title: Director of Platform Operations
Location: Bristol or London (Including hybrid)

Team: Product & Tech Operations

This role is based in either Bristol or London and requires an existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

This is a global leadership role accountable for how clients experience Kaluza day to day. Reporting to the VP Product & Tech Operations, you'll run three global functions and hold global accountability for client support and SLA performance across every client and region:

  • Client Support (incl. Incident & Problem Management) - our client-facing service desk, owning triage and first-contact resolution, incident response and the client/product-team relationship.
  • Kaluza Platform Performance Assurance (KPPA) - our neutral source of truth on platform performance, monitoring contractual SLAs and journey health per client.
  • Kaluza Product Specialists (KPS) - Global retail-energy experts fixing broken journeys and operational gaps outside core platform coverage - driving an automation-by-default approach across all client brands 

You'll lead the practice / craft globally, set the strategy and standard for how each operates, and be the steady, credible presence clients and colleagues rely on - from a board-level service review to a live Sev1. Specifically, you'll:

Client Support, Incident & Problem Management

  • Own incident response end to end - severity, Major Incident command, root cause analysis, client communication and resolution within contractual SLAs.
  • Manage incoming support requests.
  • Own Problem Management, driving root-cause remediation and reducing the rate and duration of incidents.
  • Keep support frictionless - shielding Product & Engineering from noise while closing the loop with clients, and making sure postmortems land as real systemic change.

SLA & Performance Assurance (KPPA)

  • Own global monitoring of contractual SLAs, KPIs and performance metrics as the agreed source of truth per client.
  • Run the assurance loop - prevent, diagnose, treat - and coordinate performance reporting into Client Service Reviews and senior leadership, raising events when performance deviates.
  • Hold the line on data integrity (Datadog, Jira, Databricks) and embed Kaluza's Global Standard SLAs consistently across regions.
  • Own the commercial relationship, budget and roadmap with our key Operational tooling vendors
  • Provide oversight and inputs on commercial conversations related to client reporting of performance. 

Operational Resolution & Product Specialists (KPS)

  • Own the processes that fix broken journeys and coverage gaps across all of our client brands, including new clients as we grow.
  • Balance scheduled and ad-hoc work while keeping a safe, well-governed operational estate.
  • Feed recurring manual interventions back to Product & Tech as signals for systemic fixes, and drive down manual effort through automation and AI.

Across all three, you'll be genuinely AI-native - pushing AI into support, assurance and operations so each function does more with less - and you'll operate fluently at every altitude, staying neutral, evidence-led and a steady presence under pressure.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • An accomplished operations and support leader with a strong track record.
  • A builder, not an executor - you define what good looks like, take full accountability, and go looking for what you need rather than waiting for a brief.
  • Genuinely AI-native - AI feels like leverage, and you actively push it into support, assurance and operational delivery.
  • Steady in ambiguity - nimble, sharp and decisive in a live incident, and a steady presence clients and colleagues rely on.
  • Experienced leading client support, service operations or service management at scale, ideally across multiple regions and enterprise clients.
  • Fluent in incident and problem management (severity and Major Incident command, postmortem culture, root-cause remediation) and in managing against contractual SLAs.
  • Able to understand, or quickly master, retail-energy operations and the operational reality of running processes around a platform.

What will set you apart

  • Comfortable with the data and tooling of assurance - SLAs, KPIs, observability (Datadog), Jira Service Management, and BI/warehouse tooling (Databricks/BigQuery) - enough to challenge the numbers, not just receive them.
  • A credible partner to senior leadership and C-level clients, especially in a tense service review or live incident.
  • A strong people leader and coach across multiple disciplines, able to build a self-solving, high-performing culture.
  • Committed to radical candour and customer centricity, with experience scaling a high-growth SaaS business.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme
  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP
  • Life Assurance
  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app
  • Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests
  • Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts
  • 5% Flex Fund - to spend on the benefits you want most
  • 26 days holiday
  • Flexible Bank Holidays - Giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like
  • Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including up to 26 weeks full pay for primary caregivers and 4 weeks full pay for secondary caregivers when welcoming a new addition to your family.
  • Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow!
  • Home Office Budget
  • And more!

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life - our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Product professional to lead the evolution of Work Management capabilities within WPP Open, WPP's AI-powered platform.

The candidate will have experience building or managing enterprise work management, project management and workflow automation. You will understand how large organizations plan, assign, execute, approve and measure work at scale, and how technology can remove friction from these processes.

Leveraging this expertise, you will closely collaborate with the broader product leadership team to ensure that strategy effectively aligns with and advances our overarching vision across the entire product portfolio and to provide our agencies and their clients with a competitive advantage through the application of data and technology.

This role requires a person who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, helping shape how work gets done across WPP while ensuring Open can integrate seamlessly into the workflows our clients use.

  • Provide day-to-day vision, direction and motivation to the cross-functional product team, including product management, data analysts, engineers and product enablement.
  • Utilize data to drive product strategies and plans, gathering quantitative and qualitative feedback from users and stakeholders to enhance product adoption and usage continually.
  • Promote best practices of Product Management and Ownership throughout the team, identifying and implementing areas for improvement. Offer guidance and coaching to Product Managers and Product Owners to elevate processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Support development teams through definition of requirements, product reviews, user acceptance testing, and sign-off against requirements and specifications.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by balancing platform priorities with the needs of agencies, operations teams and clients. Keep them up to date with strategic direction and the product roadmap, and communicate new product releases to ensure successful advocacy and adoption.

  • Experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related roles.
  • Proven track record delivering enterprise SaaS products, workflow platforms, work management solutions, or operational systems.
  • Understanding of Project and task management, Workflow analysis, transformation and automation, Approval workflows, Agency best practice operations and delivery processes
  • Direct experience with working with work management platforms and understand how these tools are deployed and integrated within agencies, enterprises, and client organizations.
  • Proficiency in leading and implementing agile development frameworks for delivering technical products, coupled with experience collaborating with cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering products that integrate with third-party enterprise systems. Understanding of APIs, system integrations, workflow orchestration and data interoperability.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients that require integration with proprietary or client-specific systems.
  • Familiar with AI-enabled workflow automation and agentic systems.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid

As an Experimentation & Tracking Engineer, you will own web experimentation at Alma: the A/B tests we run on merchant websites, the measurement of what happens on our own website, and its continued development following our recent redesign.

Your responsibilities will include:

Lead merchant experimentation from opportunity to readout

  • Qualify testing opportunities against technical and volume eligibility criteria, then design each test with the merchant: scenario, traffic split, pages, events, KPIs, duration, and stopping rule.
  • Implement variations and event tracking in Kameleoon, run the live phase, check data quality, and present the first results to the merchant alongside the Account Manager and Business Analysts.

Own web tracking and measurement quality

  • Define and maintain the tracking plan for Alma's website across 8 markets, implementing it through GTM, GA4, or equivalent tools.
  • Ensure reliable data flows into Salesforce, BigQuery, and Looker, while owning consent and GDPR compliance, deduplication, attribution, and reconciliation across sources.

Build and optimize almapay.com

  • Build and evolve landing pages, product pages, market pages, and local content following the website redesign.
  • Run a CRO programme on Alma's own funnels, starting with the demo request, while maintaining performance, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, and hreflang across markets.

Scale the experimentation practice

  • Turn the existing framework, documentation, and tooling into a repeatable practice, with a target of 8 merchant tests going live over the year.
  • Share standards, learnings, and results with Growth, Revenue Operations, Data, Marketing, Sales, and Product stakeholders.

🧰 You will work with

Kameleoon, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Salesforce, BigQuery, Looker, Looker Studio, Metabase, n8n, Make, Notion, Slack, GitHub.

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Overview

We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Modernization Execution: Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.
  • AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling: Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.
  • Consultative Engineering & Change Management: Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.
  • Hands-on Software Development: Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.
  • Feedback Loop: Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.
  • Standards & Quality: Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.
  • Full Stack Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java).
  • Cloud Native & IaC: Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform.
  • Consulting & Change Management: Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices.
  • Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

Preferred Skills (A Plus)

  • Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization.
  • Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar.
  • Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda).

Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself. Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Position Summary

In this role, you will serve as a trusted trade compliance partner supporting some of Metrea’s most advanced aerospace, mission systems, cyber, and technology programs. You will lead classification and export control analyses, work directly with engineers and program teams, and help enable international business activities while ensuring compliance with UK and global export control requirements. You will be successful if you enjoy solving complex technical problems, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are passionate about leveraging technology and scalable processes to improve compliance outcomes. 

What You'll Do

  • Classify hardware, software, technical data, and services under UK Strategic Export Control Lists and applicable U.S. export control regulations
  • Partner with engineering and technical teams to understand system capabilities and determine accurate export control classifications
  • Develop and maintain defensible classification analyses and audit-ready compliance documentation
  • Support preparation, submission, and management of export authorizations through UK licensing systems, including SPIRE and LITE
  • Advise business stakeholders on export licensing requirements, technology transfers, international collaborations, and cross-border business activities
  • Serve as a trusted compliance resource for program teams, business development, operations, and leadership
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess impacts to Metrea programs and technologies
  • Improve and scale classification, licensing, and compliance workflows through automation and process enhancement initiatives
  • Support internal audits, compliance assessments, and corrective action activities
  • Deliver export control and trade compliance training to technical and non-technical stakeholders

What You Bring

Must Haves 

  • 5-7 years of experience in export controls, trade compliance, or international trade within aerospace, defense, cyber, telecommunications, or advanced technology industries
  • Strong knowledge of UK Strategic Export Controls and export licensing requirements
  • Understanding of European export control regimes and cross-border transfer considerations within Europe. 
  • Strong working knowledge of export classification methodologies, jurisdiction determinations, and licensing workflows
  • Experience classifying military, dual-use, software, or technology products
  • Working knowledge of U.S. ITAR and EAR regulations
  • Experience collaborating with engineering or technical teams to translate product capabilities into export control determinations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex technical information
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to provide practical, business-focused compliance guidance
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

Nice to Haves 

  • Experience interacting with the UK Export Control Joint Unit (ECJU) and managing UK export authorization applications
  • Experience implementing compliance technology, workflow automation, data analytics, or process improvement initiatives
  • Knowledge of EU export controls, sanctions regulations, or multinational compliance frameworks
  • Professional certification in export controls, international trade, customs, or compliance disciplines

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain and maintain UK Security Clearance (SC), if required
  • Ability to travel occasionally within the UK and internationally in support of business requirements
  • Ability to work with export-controlled information and sensitive government or customer data in accordance with applicable regulations and company policies

Benefits

  • Private Medical Insurance  
  • Subsided gym membership / plans through Wellhub  
  • Electric Car scheme  
  • Cycle to work scheme  
  • Salary sacrificed pension scheme  
  • Free lunch on office days  
  • Enhanced Parental Leave  
  • 30 days annual PTO plus b/h  
  • Bonus Scheme  
  • Personal development opportunities 

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

The employee will have the legal right to work in the UK and will be able to produce right to work documentation.  

AAP/EEO Statement

Metrea Management Limited (MAM) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.  

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. 

Work Environment

This job operates in an office setting, 3 days per week in our Hammersmith office. 

Travel

10-15% 

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

description:
Lead Data Engineer - HR Data Migration (Workday) - People VF

Dans le cadre d'un remplacement en interne, nous recrutons un·e Lead Data Engineer, basé·e à Lille.

Nous souhaitons accélérer la transformation et la digitalisation de nos processus RH, en partie grâce à une forte maîtrise de nos données People et de leurs usages. Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous déployons une plateforme RH mondiale (Workday) qui intégrera un CORE RH et plusieurs modules de talent management pour les 65 pays dans lesquels Decathlon est implanté.

Votre mission : Au croisement de la stratégie et de l'exécution technique, vous serez le/la garant·e technique de la migration de nos données depuis nos systèmes legacy vers Workday. En tant que Lead Data Engineer, vous concevrez l'architecture de transformation, piloterez la création des pipelines de données, et mettrez en place un monitoring rigoureux pour assurer une migration "zéro défaut". Vous travaillerez sous la responsabilité du Program Leader et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes projet locales et globales.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

1. Architecture et Stratégie de Transformation des données :

  • Définir l'architecture technique et la stratégie de migration des données de nos systèmes sources (legacies) vers le template cible Workday.

  • Identifier le périmètre technique de la migration et concevoir des modèles de données répondant aux exigences fonctionnelles et de sécurité.

  • Documenter de manière précise les systèmes sources, les flux, et les règles de transformation complexes.

description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here. We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of German markets and business models Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible. Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets. You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments. This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification. What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in the Germany. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. Interview process Initial interview Take-home exercise Final interview (in-person) Offer, references, and welcome to the team! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé. Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs. Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé. Au sein de l'équipe Supply Chain basée à Issy-les-Moulineaux, nous recherchons un·e Junior Supply Chain Engineer – Opérations en CDI. Vous serez le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France et aux États-Unis, et le référent des opérations physiques : rework, reconditionnement, opérations à valeur ajoutée et retours B2B et B2C. En collaboration avec les équipes ADV, Planning, Qualité et Service Client, ainsi qu'avec nos collègues aux États-Unis et en Chine, vous veillerez à la fiabilisation de ces flux, à l'évaluation de leur performance et de leurs coûts. Vos missions principales : 1. Entrepôts et stocks Être le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France, aux États-Unis et en Asie, et veiller au respect des process. Garantir la fiabilité des stocks : inventaires tournants et trimestriels, réconciliation 3PL / ERP, traitement du stock dormant. Mettre en place les opérations à valeur ajoutée : rework, kitting, personnalisation. 2. Retours et reconditionnement Gérer les retours B2B et B2C, et harmoniser les process entre l'Europe, les États-Unis et l'Asie. Piloter la chaîne de refurb (diagnostic, tests qualité, remise en stock) et le suivi des pièces détachées. 3. Performance et coûts Suivre les KPIs opérationnels (stocks, délais, retours, transporteurs) et produire le reporting mensuel. Analyser les coûts logistiques, contrôler la facturation des prestataires et identifier des leviers d'économie. 4. Automatisation et process Automatiser les flux de données avec nos prestataires (Python, API, Shopify Flow) et maintenir les tableaux de bord de l'équipe. Rédiger et tenir à jour les procédures opérationnelles (SOP). Requirements Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +5 spécialisé dans la Supply ou issu d’une école d’ingénieur ou équivalent. Une première expérience (stage, alternance ou 0 à 2 ans) en logistique, entreposage ou opérations. Vous maîtrisez Excel, savez travailler avec SQL et analyser des bases de données ; des connaissances en Python sont un vrai atout. Vous connaissez le fonctionnement d'un ERP et d'un WMS, et vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques (Pack Office, Google Suite, IA). Anglais professionnel courant : vous travaillerez au quotidien avec des prestataires et des collègues en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Asie. Rigueur, proactivité, autonomie, sens de l'organisation et adaptabilité : vous êtes force de proposition et d'amélioration. Vous avez une aisance relationnelle pour faire avancer des sujets avec des partenaires externes et des équipes internes variées. Benefits Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est : Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore Participer à la Withings Med Academy en assistant à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites ! Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.
