description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

 

👐 About the team

Growth is part of the Revenue team. We build Alma's merchant acquisition engine: which merchants we target, how we find, identify and qualify them, how fast a qualified merchant reaches the right salesperson and, with lifecycle, how we convert, activate and retain them, in France and in our international markets.

We work AI-native, by design. Everyone in Growth works in Claude Code with a shared library of skills and connectors, a common repository that holds our workflow spec, our decision log and our merchant context, and a simple delivery lifecycle (Research → Spec → Plan → Build) where each stage ends with a human decision. Claude does the legwork; a person decides. Correctness comes from automated verification (tests, adversarial agent review, live validation), and every production change goes through a pull request with a named reviewer from DevX or SRE.

We are rebuilding our GTM system around five layers: market definition, signals, data & enrichment, decision & routing, and activation. As part of it, we are moving our merchant lifecycle off HubSpot to a modern customer engagement platform. Braze leads, Customer.io is in the running, and we want your view. You will lead that migration and the lifecycle programme built on top of it.

You will join a team of 6 with a Growth Ops, a Growth Engineer, a Paid Acquisition Manager, a Senior GTM Engineer (hiring) and an Experimentation & Tracking Engineer (hiring), and you will report to Julian, Team Lead Growth.

 

This position is a permanent contract (CDI) based in Paris, hybrid.

💼 About the job

Own the B2B lifecycle, from lead to active merchant

  • Design and run the journeys that drive revenue: lead nurturing, onboarding, activating signed merchants who haven't taken a first payment, retention and win-back.
  • Reach the right merchants at the right moment with the right message, using segments built on live data (industry, size, country, TPV, product usage).
  • Run a yearly campaign calendar (seasonal moments, product launches, credit upsell) next to the always-on journeys, with clear pressure rules. Start with email, then add in-app, POS materials for in-store merchants, and new channels when the data supports them.

Help drive Alma's move towards consumers

  • Alma is opening up to B2C, with new consumer products on the way. You'll be the first lifecycle person to work on it, and you'll get to invent how Alma talks to consumers.
  • It starts small next to the merchant work and is set to grow fast.

Lead the migration off HubSpot

  • Help pick the platform. Braze is the front-runner, and if you think Customer.io or another tool fits better, make the case.
  • Audit what runs today, decide what to rebuild, improve or drop, and plan the switch so no key communication stops along the way.
  • With the Growth Engineer and Data, define the data model, consent management and deliverability setup, then switch off HubSpot marketing on schedule.

Measure what you ship

  • Use control groups and A/B tests by default. Report on activations, reactivations and influenced TPV rather than open rates.
  • Build your own segments and analyses, and share what works with Sales, Account Management and Revenue Marketing.

Be the CRM project lead across Revenue

  • Align Sales, Account Management, Ops, Product Marketing, Brand and Legal on shared campaigns: you own the brief-to-delivery workflow, set the pace and arbitrate.
  • Make other teams autonomous on simple communications (templates, tone of voice, golden rules), so you can focus on the programmes that move revenue.

 

🗓️ Your first months

  • Months 1–3: you audit our current lifecycle (HubSpot workflows, onboarding emails, scattered tools), give your recommendation on the target platform and define its setup with the Growth Engineer, and keep priority campaigns running while you prepare the switch.
  • By month 6: onboarding, activation and retention journeys run on the new platform with control groups; HubSpot marketing is switched off; a yearly campaign calendar is shared with Sales, Account Management and Product Marketing.

🧰 You will work with

  • Lifecycle: Braze, Customer.io or equivalent (decision in progress). HubSpot until we switch it off.
  • Revenue systems & data: Salesforce (system of record), BigQuery, Looker
  • AI & delivery: Claude Code (skills, connectors), Notion, Linear

 

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • 5+ years in lifecycle, CRM or marketing automation, across both B2B and B2C. On the B2B side, you have run programmes hand in hand with Sales or Account Management on large portfolios (1,000+ accounts). On the B2C side, you have built consumer activation and engagement journeys at scale.
  • A campaign manager first: you turn a business goal into a segment, a timing and a message, and you can show the revenue impact of your past programmes.
  • Hands-on with a modern customer engagement platform: Braze, Customer.io, Iterable or equivalent. You build journeys, segments and personalisation yourself, and you have opinions on what each tool does well and where it falls short. Having led or contributed to a platform migration is a strong asset.
  • Data autonomy: you pull your own segments and results from a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), design tests with control groups, and understand how data flows between a CRM, a warehouse and a marketing platform.
  • Cross-functional leadership: you have owned projects involving several teams without formal authority, and you know how to prioritise when everyone needs your time.
  • Excellent writing in native-level French (mandatory) and fluent English.

 

And it will be nice if you also

  • Have set up Braze, Customer.io or a similar platform from scratch, or helped choose one.
  • Have set up email deliverability (sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, IP warm-up).
  • Already use AI in your daily work for copy, QA or analysis.
  • Have worked in fintech, payments, a card launch, or with retail merchant networks.
  • Speak Spanish, Italian or German.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

 

🧘 What's in it for you

  • Impact: 26,000 merchants in 10 countries, thousands of signed merchants still to activate, and a consumer audience to build. Every journey you ship shows up in TPV.
  • A clean start: you join in time to weigh in on the platform and set it up properly (data model, deliverability, governance) instead of inheriting years of workflow debt.
  • Leverage: an AI-native team and engineers next to you for the data plumbing, so you spend your time on segments, messages and results.
  • Team: a Team Lead Growth who designed this way of working, and close partners in Sales, Account Management, Ops and Product Marketing.

 

🤑 Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full remote contracts)
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

 

🎯 Interview Process

  • Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation & present you the role.
  • Video call with your future manager to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.
  • Case study (in house) with a panel of Revenue leaders: design a lifecycle programme for a merchant segment, plus a hands-on exercise in a marketing automation tool.
  • 1 or 2 additional interviews: meetings with Revenue stakeholders (Ops, Account Management, Product Marketing) to assess business sense and team fit.

 

🌍 Diversity & Inclusion

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Work with IT Operations and OEM service partners to prioritize material flows during incidents and reduce mean time to restore affected compute capacity. Create clear operating rhythms and decision records across engineering, deployment, site teams and suppliers; escalate risks early and close actions with evidence. Establish clear performance expectations, measurable objectives, and development plans; conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback and coaching. Drive standardization of processes, procedures, and best practices across regions while accommodating local operational and regulatory requirements. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence. Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to anticipate resource requirements, address organizational gaps, and ensure effective coordination across teams. Critical spare parts are available according to risk-based targets, reducing restoration delays and avoidable downtime. Strong cross-functional communication, supplier management and problem-solving skills; professional English and willingness to travel to operational sites. Preferred qualifications Experience supporting data centers, AI/HPC infrastructure, hyperscale hardware deployments, enterprise IT logistics or complex industrial equipment. Experience implementing warehouse management, enterprise resource planning or IT asset-management systems and inventory dashboards. Experience with international shipping, freight forwarding, customs interfaces, repair/RMA workflows and multi-site critical spares strategies. Als Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d) bei FlixTrain verantwortest du die Technologie, die bestimmt, wie unsere Fahrgäste an Bord verbunden sind, navigieren und jede Reise erleben - von WLAN und Netzwerk-Infrastruktur über On-Board-Units bis hin zu mobilen Endgeräten für unser Zugpersonal. In einer Bahnwelt, in der Konnektivität zum entscheidenden Differenzierungsmerkmal wird und Technologien wie Starlink neu definieren, was möglich ist, prägst du unmittelbar, wie FlixTrain vorne bleibt und weiterhin hochwertige, unvergessliche Reisen bietet. Als Teil des Product-Development-Teams im Bereich Rolling-Stock & Maintenance sorgst du dafür, dass unsere On-Board-Hardware ein herausragendes Reiseerlebnis für unsere Fahrgäste, einen reibungslosen Betrieb und eine gute Arbeitsumgebung für unser Zugpersonal ermöglicht. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie FlixTrain im Wettbewerb um Konnektivität an Bord die Nase vorn behält und verlässliche, hochwertige Reiseerlebnisse liefert. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Operations, Customer Product und FlixTech sowie mit externen Partnern wie Talgo, ECMs und Lieferanten (z. B. Icomera, Advantech) zusammen. Über die Rolle Du verantwortest das gesamte On-Board-Technologie-Ökosystem von FlixTrain - WLAN, Netzwerke, On-Board-Units und mobile Endgeräte - und gibst dich nie mit dem Status quo zufrieden Als zentrale technische Ansprechperson für alle On-Board-Systeme bewertest du Spezifikationen, wägst Trade-offs ab und triffst fundierte, gut begründete Entscheidungen Kontinuierlich überwachst du die Performance unserer On-Board-Technologie, erkennst Probleme frühzeitig und treibst Verbesserungen voran, die jede Reise reibungsloser machen Cross-funktionale Projekte rund um Konnektivität, Netzwerk-Performance und die Integration mobiler Endgeräte in die Fahrzeugflotte leitest du eigenverantwortlich und mit klarem Fokus auf Wirkung Technische Spezifikationen und Netzwerkarchitekturen definierst du so, dass sie ambitioniert und zugleich umsetzbar sind und nahtlose Schnittstellen zu unserer Fahrzeugflotte gewährleisten Testszenarien und funktionale Validierungen entwickelst du - besonders an der kritischen Schnittstelle zu Kund*innen und Zertifizierungsstellen – und stellst so sicher, dass unsere Lösungen im echten Betrieb funktionieren Neue Technologien wie 5G, IoT und Starlink behältst du im Blick und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Empfehlungen für die Technologie-Roadmap von FlixTrain Über Dich Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Telekommunikation, Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich Mit mehr als zwei Jahren praktischer Erfahrung in Netzwerkarchitektur, WLAN-Systemen oder Mobile Device Management überzeugst du - idealerweise im Umfeld von Schienenfahrzeugen oder einer vergleichbar komplexen technischen Umgebung Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz zeichnet dich aus, ebenso wie nachweisliche Erfahrung im Troubleshooting komplexer Netzwerksysteme unter Zeitdruck Verantwortung übernimmst du gern: Du bringst Themen eigenständig zum Abschluss und leitest cross-funktionale Initiativen mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Teams und Disziplinen souverän Klar und überzeugend kommunizierst du mit technischen Expert*innen wie auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern, ohne dabei an Präzision zu verlieren Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit, da du in einem internationalen Team arbeitest und mit deutschsprachigen Lieferanten und Behörden zusammenarbeitest Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung mit Lieferanten von Schienenfahrzeugsystemen sowie Vertrautheit mit dem vertraglichen, technischen und regulatorischen Umfeld der Bahnbranche Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Was Wir Bieten Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten. Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. Warum Teil von Flix werden? Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. description: 🐼 Qui est Alan ? En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. description:
Since 2004, we’ve been bringing investment ideas to life and connecting capital with the right people and opportunities. Today, we manage more than £2.5 billion for a broad range of investors across five key investment strategies: Private Credit, Social Housing, Clean Heat, Energy and Venture. These strategies underpin the innovative range of investments we offer to both private (retail) and institutional clients. 

There are 230+ employees at Triple Point, all committed to leaving the world demonstrably better than we found it. That’s why we’re a certified B Corp, signed up to the Principles for Responsible Investment, and were named a Sunday Times 'Best Place to Work  2025 & 2026'.

If this sounds like an environment where you would flourish, then read on…

 

The Function & Team

Triple Point Specialty Finance provides revolving credit facility (RCF) warehouse funding to UK alternative lenders, supplying liquidity and capital to parts of the non-bank lending market that might otherwise be underserved. It's a fast-growing division within Triple Point Private Credit and is a strong opportunity for someone from a structured finance, capital markets or securitisation background, with a working knowledge of LMA documentation, to take genuine ownership of deals from origination through to Credit Committee and completion.

 

Key Responsibilities& The Role

As an Origination Director, you'll own a portfolio of asset-backed facility relationships end-to-end: sourcing and structuring new transactions, leading Credit Committee presentations, and managing your book through legal completion and beyond. You'll lead new transactions, represent Triple Point at industry events, and help broaden the introducer network that feeds the wider team's pipeline.

Beyond your own deals, you'll be a visible market voice internally, and supporting colleagues on complex or strategic opportunities across the existing portfolio. The team is currently building out new capabilities, including Forward Flow, mezzanine and incubator strategies, so there is real scope to help shape where Specialty Finance goes next rather than simply execute what's already established.

  • Transaction Delivery: Lead the end-to-end structuring and delivery of a minimum of three new money debt transactions a year, for both new and existing Triple Point borrowers, from origination through to legal completion.
  • Credit Committee & Relationship Management: Present transactions to Credit Committee and manage relationships with the management teams of new and existing borrowers throughout the deal lifecycle.
  • Origination & Market Profile: Build and maintain a network of borrowers and intermediaries; represent Triple Point at a minimum of four industry or sector events a year to build the Specialty Finance profile and broaden the introducer base.
  • Portfolio & Risk Monitoring: Analyse borrower financials, loan portfolios and borrowing base information to identify, communicate and challenge early warning signs; ensure internal risk and portfolio reporting, including Aspire, is accurate and complete at all times.
  • Market Knowledge & Internal Insight: Maintain current knowledge of the UK Specialty Finance and asset-backed finance markets, including products, competitors, pricing and opportunity, and share this with Credit, RST and Management to increase internal awareness of the sector.
  • Supporting the Wider Team: Support on complex or strategic opportunities within the existing portfolio, and help mentor more junior colleagues (Associate Directors, Portfolio Managers) in deal skills and credit judgement.

 

Experience

  • Specialty Finance Experience: Extensive experience in lending and loan documentation across a bank or non-bank environment, including a minimum of 3 years in Specialty Finance or a related field such as structured finance, capital markets or securitisation, with a particular focus on asset-backed financing.
  • Deal Leadership: Track record of leading transactions end-to-end, including preparing and presenting detailed credit applications for new money transactions, ideally from a front-office debt origination or structuring role.
  • Financial Analysis & Modelling: Strong proficiency in Excel for analysing financial models, loan tapes and financial statements, including sensitivity analysis and portfolio wind-down scenarios; ability to read and analyse company accounts, management information and forecasts.
  • Negotiation: A confident, independent negotiator, able to identify Triple Point's non-negotiable terms while finding solutions that keep borrowers engaged.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills, comfortable presenting to Credit Committee and managing workflows across multiple external parties, including borrowers and legal counsel.
  • Stakeholder Management: A strong relationship-builder, both internally (Credit, Risk, Portfolio, Management) and externally (borrowers, brokers, advisers, private equity firms).
  • Education: Degree level, ideally supported by a professional qualification in accountancy, banking or risk management.

 

Personal Qualities

How You'll Work — Our Values in Action

  • Stay Curious: You ask questions that change how we do things and spot ideas to grow assets or fee income in new ways; you keep a genuine pulse on market conditions, competitor activity and investor appetite.
  • Be Generous: You share your network and market knowledge freely, and help more junior colleagues develop their deal and credit skills.
  • Thoughtful Action: You balance commercial acumen with risk management, identifying issues and pain points ahead of time and simplifying complexity for others.
  • Pull Together: You collaborate across Credit, RST and Management, staying aware of the team's capacity constraints and stepping in to help where useful.
  • Own It: You take full accountability for your transactions and portfolio, acting as a steward of Triple Point's capital from origination through to completion.

 

Why Join us?

  • You’ll join a talented, collaborative team in a connected environment where ideas and initiative are valued.
  • Be part of a growing and innovative team
  • We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and genuine opportunities for growth and progression.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

At Triple Point, high performance means living our values every day:

·       Stay Curious.

·       Be Generous.

·       Take Thoughtful Action.

·       Pull Together.

·       Own It.

In line with our values Stay Curious and Take Thoughtful Action every employee has access to AI tools. We see technology as a co-pilot, helping us improve efficiency and insight while keeping decisions grounded in thoughtful human judgement.

 

 

Triple Point offers a wealth of benefits including a contributory pension, hybrid/flexible working and ongoing learning and development opportunities. Check out our comprehensive list of benefits HERE.

description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Localisation et déplacements Poste basé à Paris, selon la politique hybride de Pennylane, avec des déplacements réguliers en France auprès des partenaires, de leurs équipes et lors d’événements professionnels. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager. Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ? Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant. Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action : Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur. Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes. Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes. Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles. Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu. 2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire. Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable. Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane. Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés. Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion. 3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires. Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe. Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau. Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation. Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats. 4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes. Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités. Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs. Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux. Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire. 5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales. Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires. Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat. Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage. Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence. 6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées. Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales. Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires. Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective. Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires. Profil recherché : Compétences incontournables : Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs; Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes; Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles; Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes; Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit; Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée; Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps; Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM; Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations; Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais. Atouts appréciés Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME; Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B. Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients; Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell. Ce que nous recherchons surtout : Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui : Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain; Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables; Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien; Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe; A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques. Process de recrutement : Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane. 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind) 🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile) 🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés 🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking 🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris 💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE 🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib 💻 Un Mac 🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: -Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules) -Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant -Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes -Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. In this role you will independently manage less-defined and more complex risk work while contributing to team projects and operational improvements. This role builds on Analyst I capability by recognising patterns, expanding findings, suggesting solutions, and applying sound judgement with minimal direction. What you’ll be doing: Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to: Manage complex transaction, merchant, onboarding, fraud, credit, and compliance cases across risk queues, owning end-to-end assessments using merchant,business, account, transaction, and other risk signals. Apply company, partner, supportability, and restricted-product policies to less-defined reviews with minimal direction, weighing competing factors and making sound decisions with imperfect information. Use reports, risk signals, case trends, operational data, and web-service tools to identify emerging threats, high-risk or suspicious activity, and opportunities for proactive mitigation. Balance portfolio protection and chargeback risk by assessing chargeback likelihood alongside the merchant’s capacity to repay. Resolve compliance violations and complex cases, identify material risks, escalate unresolved issues appropriately, and contribute to resolution and follow-up. Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and risk patterns across tools, workflows, queues, policies, and playbooks, and recommend practical improvements. Produce concise case summaries, findings, recommendations, and decision rationale; maintain accurate documentation and contribute to knowledge material, playbooks, and team learning. Lead complex customer communications and collaborate with Support, FS Merchant Services, Product, risk analysts, and other teams to resolve shared problems. Contribute to incidents, complex reviews, trend investigations, projects, process improvements, and team best practices while prioritising competing work effectively. What you need to bring: We are looking for a highly analytical and collaborative professional with experience within a relevant analyst role along with: 2 years of experience in payments, fraud, credit risk, compliance, or financial services operations or related discipline. Exposure to structured workflows, case management, queues, or service-level targets. Experience working with written procedures and maintaining accurate records. Interest in deepening existing knowledge on fraud, credit risk, merchant risk, and payments and suggesting improvements based on said knowledge. Knowledge of Card Scheme rules and regulations Understanding of the full Chargeback flow and process - Understanding chargeback risk timeframes. Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets Good conceptual thinking with proven analytic, problem-solving and effective reporting skills Experience managing structured case work with increasing complexity and limited direction. Ability to work independently and make decisions based on available information Ability to work in a dynamic fast-paced environment with tight deadlines We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! What’s in it for you: Come live the Lightspeed Experience… Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about Fraud & Risk as you are An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story … and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy: Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Flexible Paid Time Off - providing you the freedom to take time off however you like Private Medical Insurance and cash health plan for optical, dental and more. Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 GBP per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the LifeWorks and Modern Health Apps- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform Time off to volunteer and give back to your community Transit / parking benefit - for when you need to travel to the Belfast office A variety of drinks & snacks in our offices in Belfast. To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here. Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Health can’t wait. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. The M&A and International Expansion role Alan is diversifying its activities in the fields of healthcare, prevention and insurance through mergers and acquisitions, and is actively expanding internationally. In addition, Alan recruits talent worldwide and enables its employees to work remotely in complete safety. “Alaner, everywhere”. The role makes sure each acquisition and each country opening is legally secure, fast and humane: from HR due diligence, to transferring employment contracts, to fully integrating the people who join us. You'll join the Expansion crew inside the People team. You'll work closely with the crew owner, and with Corporate, Finance, team Leads and General Managers involved in each deal. The People team The People team is made up of 13 people who work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every one of them is a genuine fan of our products (Culture being one of them) and deeply committed to Alan's Prevention and Health mission. The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, Comp and Ben, and now M&A and International Expansion. It is a generalist team: everyone shares three core missions, namely People on-call (answering the day to day questions from Alaners, which is now AI-powered), individual situation management, and HRBP responsibilities. This represents roughly 50% of our time. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: M&A and expansion. Your missions On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a very diverse range of high-impact topics: You will own to the People workstream of M&A transactions from due diligence to integration, alongside the crew and in close collaboration with the Corporate team, Legal, Finance and the business owners of each deal. Depending on the nature of the deal, you will own: HR due diligence: reviewing headcount, employment contracts, collective agreements, compensation & benefits, liabilities and risks of target companies, and flagging red flags clearly to the deal team; Transferring employment contracts in France and abroad, and choosing the right path for each deal and country; Integrating acquired teams: day-1 and first-months plans, harmonising contracts and benefits, communicating with acquired employees, onboarding them into Alan's way of working; You will support the people transition of acquired teams, working with the crew and leads on team set-up, keeping key talents, and supporting every individual situation with care; Working with external advisors (law firms, HR advisory, relocation and EoR providers): writing clear briefs and challenging their advice. Also: Opening new countries on the People side: entity vs employer of record, compliant local contracts, benefits and payroll partners You will handle international relocations and cross-border situations for Alaners moving or working between countries (visas, social security, tax, type of contract); Building reusable playbooks (HR due diligence checklist, integration playbook, "country opening – People" checklist) so each new deal is faster than the last Taking on global and cross-border individual situations (mobility, work from anywhere, sensitive cases) Raising the team's expertise: sharing your knowledge of employment law and M&A practices with the crew and the wider People team Leveraging AI and automation to multiply the impact of your work Outcomes within your first months in the team By 2.5 months: You are autonomous on day-to-day People on-call requests; You have mapped our current M&A and country-opening practices and shared a first list of gaps and quick wins; You have contributed to the People workstream of at least one live deal or country opening (due diligence, contract transfer or integration); You have contributed to our reusable playbook (e.g. HR due diligence checklist); You have shadowed and been reverse-shadowed on individual situation management. By 5 months: Depending on the ongoing projects, you own the People workstream of a deal end to end, from due diligence to integration, with the crew as a sounding board; You have run, or co-run, one talent density assessment and the parting ways cases that came with it; You handle cross-border individual situations without supervision; Your playbooks are used by the crew and by Legal / Finance on new deals; Leads and crew members come to you as the go-to expert on these topics. Is this what you are looking for? You may be a great fit for this role if: You have around 5 years of experience focused on HR M&A and integration topics, for example in a reputable HR advisory firm or in an HR team that focuses on these topics. You have worked on acquisitions in the Tech industry, not only on very large corporate groups, and you know the method is not the same. You master HR due diligence and the transfer of employment contracts. You have worked on post-merger integration, including talent density and parting ways, not only on the pre-signing side. You have international exposure: you have worked on deals or entities outside France. You are fluent in English, written and spoken (all of our internal processes, documentation and communications are in English). You are adaptable and creative: you adjust your method to each type of company and deal instead of copy-pasting one process. You are very organised: you run several confidential workstreams in parallel without dropping balls. You are a strong communicator, with very different audiences (founders, acquired employees, leads, lawyers), in writing and orally. You are strong technically and can teach us things. You show judgement and discretion with confidential information and sensitive human situations. Nice-to-have We are not looking for all of the below. Any one of these can be a strong signal. You have a legal background, ideally in employment law. You have worked in or with a Tech scale-up that made several acquisitions. You have opened entities or set-up employers of record in new countries. You speak another language relevant to our expansion (e.g. Spanish, Portuguese; Arabic). You are AI-enthusiastic and actively use tools to multiply your impact. Level range For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range. description: Pharmazeutische Entwicklung, Formulierungsentwicklung, Tech Transfer & GMP Für ein etabliertes Schweizer Pharmaunternehmen suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die sich im Bereich pharmazeutische Entwicklung und Tech Transfer weiterentwickeln möchte. Die Position eignet sich besonders für Pharmazeutinnen und Pharmazeuten, die bereits erste Erfahrung in der industriellen Arzneimittelentwicklung, Herstellung oder im GMP-Umfeld gesammelt haben und nun näher an Produktentwicklung und Produktion arbeiten möchten. description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs. Contexte scientifique : La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029). Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données (data centers) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude. Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement. Au sein de la Chaire, le ou la post-doctorant(e) étudiera la manière dont les centres de données, objets clés de l’infrastructure numérique, se développent et organisent différents problèmes publics relatifs aux « territoires » à différentes échelles territoriales. Comment en retour, la définition et la hiérarchisation de ces problèmes peuvent permettent des arbitrages concertés pour planifier leur déploiement ? Les modalités de participation à la construction de ces problèmes publics, autant que la fabrique des données nécessaires pour nourrir les positions des acteurs, sont autant un enjeu de démocratie technique qu’une manière de retrouver prise sur l’aménagement des milieux de vie. En articulant sociologie des sciences et des techniques et études urbaines avec une méthodologie innovante de recherche-action, TerrAINs contribue à rendre visibles et discutables les infrastructures numériques, tout en expérimentant des outils de représentation des problèmes et de participation, adaptées aux enjeux infrastructurels contemporains. La Chaire est organisée selon trois axes principaux : Analyse des discours sur les centres de données, et notamment les discours médiatiques régionaux, nationaux et étrangers ; Description des modalités du « faire infrastructure » : pratiques situées, relations aux milieux, frictions. Cet axe investira trois sites franciliens concernés par des projets de centres hyperscale. la chaire est conçue comme un laboratoire de recherche-action qui expérimente de nouvelles modalités de représentation et de participation autour des infrastructures numériques. Vos missions principales seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le cadre de la Chaire Terrains Participer à l’animation de la chaire et contribuer aux projets menés par les autres membres de l’équipe Participer à des actions de valorisation des travaux menés au sein de la chaire Assurer des missions d’encadrement (stagiaires, workshops étudiant) Consulter la description des missions complètes dans la fiche de poste détaillée. Nous recherchons une personne avec un profil SHS – interdisciplinaire (humanités environnementales, Science and Technology Studies (STS) ou anthropologie expérimentale, géographie sociale, architecture / design…) avec une solide maîtrise théorique et empirique des transformations socio-environnementales, des savoirs situés, des problèmes publics, de l’enquête collective et des relations entre sciences / société. Niveau de diplôme exigé : doctorat ou équivalent Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Découvrez notre environnement de travail, nos engagements en image et en vidéo sur notre page dédiée. Dossier de candidature à envoyer avant le 20 novembre : un CV détaillé une lettre (2-3 pages max) qui esquisse les contributions que le ou la candidat·e souhaiterait apporter au sein de la Chaire ainsi que sa motivation à y prendre part; deux publications significatives au regard de cette intention (au-delà des critères académiques classiques) une lettre de recommandation Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 22 novembre 2026 Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois Description de poste détaillée ici Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an En fonction du statut du profil retenu et du nombre d’années après la thèse, un contrat d’ingénieur de recherche pourra être envisagé. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want. 

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one. That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

 

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Principal Engineer QA as a senior individual contributor. You will define how quality risk is assessed, measured, and gated across the full streaming path - and embed that craft into engineering teams, who own day-to-day tests and suite health.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Quality strategy & risk - Build and maintain a living risk model for the streaming chain. Raise effort where failure hurts most. Make coverage vs. speed and pre-release vs. production trade-offs explicit with product and eng.
  • Release constraints & quality gates - Define what “releasable” means for backend, middleware, and clients - including how continuous backend/middleware delivery is gated relative to client store cadences (web/TV/mobile). Keep gates fast, trustworthy, and hard to bypass.
  • Rollout practice (build with the teams) - Define and establish staged rollout, canary, and rollback strategies together with eng and SRE/ops. Own the definition; establish and operate them collaboratively.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes.
  • Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced.
  • Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live.
  • Ensure Accessibility & Compliance: Champion EU accessibility regulations by design, translating regulatory and market-specific needs into actionable engineering requirements.
  • Engage Clients & Drive Value: Serve as the trusted expert for clients on agent experience, advocating for platform-first configuration over bespoke builds
  • Hands-on Delivery & Enablement: Maintain active involvement across the entire Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC)—from agent discovery sessions to feedback loops—and produce materials to support successful client adoption.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Contact Centre & UX Expertise: Deep experience owning end-to-end user journeys for high-frequency operational tools (e.g., agent desktops), with hands-on craft in user research, journey mapping, and usability testing with agents and supervisors.
  • EU Accessibility & Platform Integration: Strong working knowledge of EU accessibility standards alongside proven experience integrating products with complex third-party platforms and vendor ecosystems.
  • Client Delivery & Market Expansion: Successful track record implementing or localizing a product for external enterprise clients, taking solutions from zero to live through discovery, configuration, and change management.
  • Data-Informed Judgement & Influence: Demonstrated ability using operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, agent effort) to defend product decisions, coupled with a platform-first mindset that prioritizes existing capabilities over custom code.
  • Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop environments.
  • Prior experience within SaaS platforms, the energy sector, or large-scale utility migrations.
  • Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.
  • Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.
  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.
  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.
  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
    Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)
  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund
  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

We want the best people
We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

description: The Challenge We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next. A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow. Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling. This is a remote opportunity. What You'll Do Own call quality holistically: hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments. Manage zones, codes, and origins: own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones. Update routing continuously: change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers. Work cross-functionally by design: partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users. Move routing toward automation: work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work. What You'll Bring Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience. NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD. Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus. Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts Who You Are Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix. Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it. A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team. Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked. Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach. Recruitment Process Recruiter screening Hiring manager screening with COO Technical interview Case study What you get Learning and growth €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. Time to recharge 25 vacation days Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview) Work from anywhere As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. A team you'll actually want to be part of Weekly team lunch every Thursday Regular team moments and outings An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond Set up for success Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance An environment to grow and make impact A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission About Talk360 Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build. Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business. As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products. Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe. Here’s what our users say: “I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★ “Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★ “It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★ Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements. Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses. Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting. Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results. You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together. What a Typical Day Looks Like Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions. You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability. Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance. Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results. description: Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 255 millions d'euros, avec 4794 employés dans le monde. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. CONTEXTE : La Direction des Programmes Internationaux (DPI) de Humanité & Inclusion comprend entre autres 5 Directions Géographiques, 4 Directions Techniques, 1 Direction Atlas Logistique et 1 Direction Urgence. La Direction Urgence est composée de 15 personnes: une équipe en charge de la veille, de l'alerte et de la préparation aux urgences et une équipe en charge des interventions d'urgence au niveau du siège et sur le terrain. C’est au sein de cette dernière, composée de 6 spécialistes des urgences et prêts à être déployés sous 72 heures que nous recrutons un ou une Responsable Réadaptation physique et Fonctionnelle en Urgence dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire. OBJECTIFS DU POSTE : Sous la responsabilité du responsable du pool d'urgence et en étroite coordination avec les Spécialistes en Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle du siège, le responsable Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle d'urgence aura la charge de : Participer au diagnostic initial des opérations de réponse d'urgence, à la suite d’une crise humanitaire ; · Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie, de la méthodologie et du dimensionnement du diagnostic initial, y compris la création et/ou l'adaptation des outils d'évaluation des besoins ; · Participer aux évaluations des besoins ; · Contribuer à l'analyse des résultats et à la définition de la stratégie de réponse immédiate en anticipant le nexus urgence-réhabilitation-développement ; · Contribuer à l'élaboration du projet et à la rédaction des propositions ; Diriger et coordonner : Piloter le déploiement des activités de réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle lors de l’ouverture de nouveaux programmes d’urgence, en assurant la définition du cadre opérationnel, le management des équipes, la coordination avec les autres secteurs d’intervention et les partenaires, ainsi que le suivi de la qualité, du budget, des résultats et du reporting. Le poste contribue également à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d’intervention d’urgence, au renforcement des capacités des équipes et partenaires, et à la capitalisation des retours d’expérience. Représenter et promouvoir le mandat d’Humanité & Inclusion dans le cadre des réponses d’urgence dans votre domaine d’expertise ; · Promouvoir le mandat et son positionnement en coordination avec les partenaires de mise en œuvre ; · Représenter et participer aux mécanismes de coordination des réponses liées à la Réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle d’urgence (groupe de travail santé, groupe de travail traumatologie etc…) · Participer, sur demande de la hiérarchie, aux actions liées aux campagnes de plaidoyer et institutionnelles mises en œuvre par Humanité & Inclusion au siège et/ou sur le terrain ; · Contribuer à la mobilisation des acteurs publics et privés pour assurer l’inclusion de la vulnérabilité et du handicap dans leurs programmes et initiatives. Contribuer à la capitalisation institutionnelle et participer au développement et à la mise à jour des méthodologies, procédures, outils et formations d'urgence d’Humanité & Inclusion. · Participer aux travaux de formalisation et de capitalisation dans son domaine d'expertise en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de secteur et le spécialiste technique du siège ; · Participer à la stratégie Direction Urgence et autres, si nécessaire ; · Contribuer de façon proactive et constructive à la conception des processus et méthodologies de réponse aux urgences ; · Contribuer au développement et/ou à l'optimisation des outils, procédures et ressources utilisés par Humanité & Inclusion pour la réponse aux urgences en étroite collaboration avec le spécialiste technique du siège. · Contribuer au renforcement des capacités de réponse aux urgences du personnel et/ou des partenaires d'Humanité & Inclusion en fonction des besoins identifiés ; · Contribuer à l'amélioration des outils et modules de formation dans ses domaines d'expertise ; · Participer activement aux ateliers organisés au sein de l'Equipe de Réponse aux Urgences ou par d'autres départements au sein d'Humanité & Inclusion, en relation avec les réponses aux urgences · Apporter un support au spécialiste technique du siège sur des sujets spécifiques et transversaux. Read on or visit our website for more information. About you As a Client Director, you will join our Client Success team and play a crucial role in maintaining and growing a portfolio of some of our largest and high-growth clients. Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you’ll be a part of a fast-growing business that is challenging the market and doing things differently. You'll take ownership of a portfolio of ClearBank's Enterprise grade clients, committing to their success, and relentlessly work to remove barriers to adoption, both within their organisation and cross-functionally within ClearBank. You will be responsible for ensuring the success of our clients and driving revenue growth. And you’ll be joining one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK, according to Deloitte Fast 50. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to effectively engage with clients and internal stakeholders at all levels, including c-suite executives. Excellent problem-solving skills, able to identify and overcome barriers to adoption and drive client success. Ability to collaborate and work effectively across multiple teams, fostering a culture of teamwork and shared goals. Strong organisational skills, able to manage multiple client relationships and prioritise tasks effectively. Inquisitive and comfortable asking questions about clients' business goals, ideal state, and pain points. Ability to analyse multiple problems, develop and drive solutions.
