description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place: serving merchants and consumers.
Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.
As the buy now, pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.
With 380+ Almakers and more than €100M in ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!
 

👐 About the team

You'll join a team made up of one manager, one team lead and five Account Performance Managers: Mathieu, Guillaume, Hugo, Gonzague and Alexandre.
The team is responsible for supporting Alma's strategic merchants, helping them grow their business with Alma and ensuring that we continue to deliver value over time.
We're looking for our next Account Performance Manager to manage a portfolio of strategic accounts and play a key role in supporting our merchants' business strategies.
This is a permanent position based in Paris.
 

💼 About the role

As an Account Performance Manager, you'll manage a portfolio of approximately 200 strategic merchants, both online and offline. These merchants generate an average annual turnover of between €1M and €3M with Alma.
Most of your portfolio will be based in France, with some international accounts as Alma continues to expand across Europe.
Your role will be to understand each merchant's business, identify opportunities for growth, maximize the value of the partnership and anticipate any behavior that could lead to churn.
SMB and Mid-Market accounts represent around 40% of Alma's margin, which makes your work critical to the company's success.

Your main responsibilities

  • Drive merchant performance
    Build strong relationships with your portfolio through proactive outreach, including calls and emails. Use Alma's dashboards and performance data to identify opportunities and provide meaningful business insights.
  • Identify growth opportunities
    Analyze merchant activity and recommend initiatives such as:
    • Upselling Alma's solutions
    • Optimizing pricing and payment plans
    • Expanding into new countries
    • Activating additional networks or channels
    • Increasing Alma's share of the merchant's payment activity
  • Improve the profitability of your portfolio
    Conduct business and financial analyses for merchants with low margins. Work with them to define and implement action plans that improve performance and help reach the expected margin target.
  • Prevent merchant churn
    Keep a close eye on merchant performance, market trends and competitor activity. Identify early warning signs and demonstrate Alma's value through relevant, data-driven recommendations.
  • Support Alma's international growth
    Work with French and international merchants and contribute to the development of best practices for managing strategic accounts across different markets.
  • Build smarter ways of working
    Contribute to improving account management processes, reporting and automation so the team can scale its impact while maintaining a high level of service.

How success will be measured

Your main objectives will be to:
  • Increase revenue through TPV growth and take-rate optimization
  • Reduce merchant churn by proactively demonstrating Alma's value
  • Maintain a strategic level of margin across your portfolio
  • Increase the adoption and expansion of Alma's solutions among strategic merchants

🧰 You will work with

You will use a combination of data, sales and collaboration tools, including: Salesforce, Gong, Dust, Performance dashboards and internal reporting tools. 
You will also work closely with teams across the organization, including Operations, Product, Sales, Risk, Finance and Marketing.
 

🧩 About you

To succeed in this role

  • You have at least three years of experience in account management, business development, sales or a similar client-facing role.
  • You have experience managing strategic B2B accounts and advising clients on their business challenges.
  • You have a strong interest in fintech and a genuine curiosity about payment products, financial performance and the broader payments ecosystem.
  • You are comfortable analyzing business and financial data and turning insights into concrete recommendations.
  • You are autonomous, organized and able to manage a portfolio while prioritizing the actions with the greatest business impact.
  • You are comfortable having challenging conversations with clients and turning them into constructive business opportunities.
  • You are fluent in French and English.

It will be a plus if you also

  • Speak Spanish, Portuguese or German.
  • Have experience working with international clients.
  • Have worked in payments, fintech, SaaS or another fast-growing technology company.
  • Have experience with pricing, margin optimization or financial analysis.
  • Are comfortable working with data dashboards, CRM tools and sales intelligence platforms.
Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.
 

🧘 About the role

If you join Alma, you will have the opportunity to grow and make an impact on:
  • A business that matters
    SMB and Mid-Market merchants represent around 40% of Alma's margin. As an Account Performance Manager, you will have a direct impact on revenue, profitability and merchant retention.
  • Strategic, high-impact accounts
    You'll work with merchants generating significant volume with Alma and help shape their payment and business strategy.
  • A broad range of skills
    From business and financial analysis to negotiation, consulting and international account management, this role will help you develop a strong 360° skill set.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional environment
    You'll work closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Risk, Finance and Marketing teams to solve merchant challenges and create long-term value.
  • A team that pushes you forward
    You'll join a close-knit, high-performing team where feedback is direct, autonomy is real and the bar is high.

🤑 Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma, including the family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and ClassPass, or €30/month reimbursement for sports activities
  • Maternity and paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave, with no seniority requirement. Return to work at a 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for eight weeks.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package: €544.80/year, excluding fully remote contracts
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to the MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year, plus additional paid leave for employees on executive contracts
  • Access to our Learning & Development platform
  • Two weeks of full remote work possible per year during the summer

🎯 Interview process

  • Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to discuss your background and motivation, and present the role and Alma.
  • Video call with your future manager to discuss the role, the team, your experience and answer your questions.
  • Case study presentation with two or three team members, ideally on site, to assess your practical knowledge and approach.
  • One or two additional interviews tailored to the role's level to further assess your skills and team fit.

🌍 Diversity & Inclusion

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected and empowered to do their best work, whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience.
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit and business needs.

description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people across 190 countries. How they find us is changing fast: Search is moving from blue links to AI generated answers and paid and organic increasingly shape each other. A missed opportunity here isn't just a lower ROAS number. It's someone staying connected with family abroad, a business trying to reach a supplier, or someone who urgently needs to reach a real phone number. As our Senior Acquisition Marketeer, you won't own a channel. You'll own the outcome: Figuring out where Talk360's next valuable user is and the smartest way to reach them, across Google, Meta, TikTok, SEO, app stores, AI search, and whatever comes next. Think investment manager for acquisition, not channel specialist. Talk360 has been profitably growing since 2025. We're a lean team of around 30 people, with the majority of team working from the Amsterdam office. We're looking for someone genuinely channel agnostic: you don't wake up thinking about Google Ads or SEO; you wake up thinking about where the next valuable Talk360 user is. What you’ll do Own the acquisition portfolio: Continuously evaluate and reallocate investment across paid channels (Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok) and organic channels (SEO, ASO, content), based on where the next euro or hour of effort returns the most. Run segment-led acquisition: Adapt proposition, creative, keywords, landing pages, and app store presence for our three core segments, Calling Home, Calling for Work, and Calling When It Counts, and learn which segment performs best in which channel, market, and corridor. Connect acquisition to LTV: Track performance past the click or install, through registration, first purchase, calling behaviour, and retention, so decisions get made on CAC and LTV together, not platform ROAS alone. Build our AI discovery presence: Develop Talk360's approach to discovery as more of our future users start their search inside AI tools instead of Google. Run a continuous experimentation pipeline: Turn acquisition hypotheses (a new high-intent search category, a different proposition, an underserved corridor, a new distribution channel) into small, fast tests, and turn the results into investment decisions. The Team You’ll join a lean Commercial team where acquisition, brand, product marketing, CRM, content and data work closely together. No big silos or layers of approval: You’ll work directly with product, data and creative to turn an insight into a live experiment quickly. What you’ll bring Strong experience running paid acquisition on Google Ads, Meta, and/or Apple Search Ads, with real budget ownership and results to show for it. Working knowledge of SEO and ASO, and a track record of building organic acquisition that compounds rather than resetting every quarter. Fluency in CAC, ROAS, conversion, ARPU, and LTV, and the ability to build one framework that lets you compare channels that have never been compared before. Comfort moving between data, creative, content, and technology to shorten the distance between an idea and a live experiment. Active, current use of AI in your own marketing workflow, for research, analysis, content variation, and speeding up execution, not just openness to using it. Who you are Channel agnostic and opportunity driven, you're motivated by finding the next valuable user, not by defending a particular channel or discipline. Comfortable moving investment away from something that isn't working anymore, even if you're the one who built it. Genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping search and discovery and energised by figuring out a playbook that doesn't exist yet rather than waiting for one. Analytical: You can find the meaningful signal inside a pile of noisy performance data and act on it. Understand the limits of attribution and don't let an imperfect model stop you from making a call. You’re able to come to our office in Amsterdam on Mondays, Wednesday and Thursdays Recruitment process First Call: a short call with our recruiter to get to know each other a bit better Hiring Manager Interview: a deep dive into your experience with the Chief Revenue Officer Case Study: visit of our office where you will present a practical task to our team Meeting with the CEO What you get Competitive compensation Senior Acquisition Marketeer salary: €80,000 – €90,000 gross per year (all-in) Learning and growth €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. Time to recharge 25 vacation days Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview) Work from anywhere As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. A team you'll actually want to be part of Weekly team lunch every Thursday Regular team moments and outings An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond Set up for success Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance An environment to grow and make impact A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission. About Talk360 Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build. Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business. As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products. Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe. Here’s what our users say: “I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★ “Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★ “It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★ Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description:
Who We Are

MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses.

About WPP

MAP is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

Are you passionate about driving innovation with Adobe Experience Cloud technologies? Do you want to collaborate with leading global enterprises to build and optimize their digital frameworks? If so, you might be the Adobe Senior Application Consultant we are looking for!

What will your day look like?

As our new Adobe Senior Application Consultant, you will become part of our growing development team. Here, you will deal with lots of moving pieces and help us build the most effective way to launch marketing campaigns at scale for global brands – focusing on making the process as seamless and efficient as possible for marketers and operations specialists while also activating new technical capabilities within the Adobe ecosystem. As an Application Consultant, you will bridge the gap between technology and marketing strategies. You will work closely with clients to understand their business objectives and translate them into technical requirements for Adobe solutions. You will collaborate with developers to ensure the technical solutions align with the client's business goals.

More specifically, your tasks include:

  • Collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team, partnering with operations and client teams to ensure seamless solution delivery and client success using Adobe platforms.
  • Driving the successful adoption of Internal enterprise marketing tools and Adobe applications across our client base by leveraging your technical expertise to configure efficient and tailored end-to-end client experiences.
  • Streamlining client operations by configuring and implementing customised business rules and automations within Adobe marketing platforms.
  • Bringing client solutions to life by configuring and implementing new features according to provided specifications and designs within Adobe environments.
  • Ensuring the quality and reliability of implementations by rigorously testing configurations and newly developed features within Adobe applications.
  • Proactively identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving technical issues within existing Adobe applications, ensuring a seamless user experience.
  • Collecting business requirements by engaging with marketers to translate them into technical specifications for Adobe solutions.
  • Utilising Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and related tools to build data audiences and manage segments while understanding their quality and integrity.
  • Contributing to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying and recommending opportunities to optimise Adobe platforms and their features.

Who are you going to work with?

You will join a team of highly skilled developers, architects, data specialists, product managers, and project managers who are passionate about building great solutions and customer experiences together. You will also get to work closely with experts from other technology, creative, and client teams.

What do you bring to the table?

As a person, you have a team player mindset and an open-minded attitude. You can communicate ideas and technical topics honestly and clearly – also to non-experts – while respecting the views of others on the team. You are eager to understand and find solutions, allowing you to quickly adapt to changing situations and come up with new ideas. As a strategic thinker, you take into consideration the big picture and critically assess the projects you're working on, consulting and advising when needed. At the same time, you solve problems analytically and pragmatically, both independently and as part of the team.

  • 5 - 8 years of relevant experience in application consulting, marketing technology, campaign operations, CRM, marketing automation, or a similar technical consulting role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with campaign execution, campaign configuration, programme builds, and marketing automation workflows.
  • Subject matter expertise in at least one major marketing technology platform, such as Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Marketo Engage, Braze or a comparable CRM or marketing automation tool.
  • Advanced understanding of campaign execution processes, including requirements assessment, technical debriefing, build, QA, testing, deployment, monitoring, and optimisation.
  • Ability to independently assess, develop, and maintain scalable, future-proof campaign solutions.
  • Experience contributing to or consulting on campaign solution design from scratch.

If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

 

Senior AR Analyst, Credit Control | London

Please note: candidate must currently reside in the UK and be able to work in the UK without sponsorship.

 

About Convene Hospitality Group

Convene Hospitality Group designs and operates experiential event venues, bringing premium meeting and event experiences to some of the world’s leading organisations. Through a growing portfolio of brands including Convene, etc.venues and NeueHouse, we operate a network of nearly 40 venues and are the largest single provider of dedicated meeting and event spaces across the US and UK.

The UK is central to that story. From our Convene venues across the City of London to etc.venues in London and Manchester, and with our new West End destination, Convene Rathbone, our UK footprint continues to grow, and so does the pace of the events we deliver. Every conference, board meeting and live event our clients host relies on a finance team that keeps things moving behind the scenes.

About the Role 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounts Receivable (AR) Analyst, Credit Control to join our UK Finance team and help lead AR operations across our UK venue portfolio. Reporting to the AR Manager, you’ll take ownership of billing, credit control and cash allocation, turning client contracts and booking data into accurate, timely invoices, following up on outstanding balances, allocating customer receipts and keeping customer accounts clean and reconciled in our financial systems.

This is a role with real visibility. You’ll work closely with Sales, Event Operations and client procurement teams, acting as a trusted partner who keeps cash flowing while protecting the strong client relationships our business is built on. For someone who brings both rigour and a commercial mindset, it’s an opportunity to make a direct impact on the financial health of a growing UK business.

 

What You’ll Do

Daily Operations & Cash Management:

  • Prepare multi-bank reconciliation spreadsheets (Santander, JPM, Online Credit Cards) and resolve unapplied cash exceptions
  • Process incoming payments (ACH, credit cards, wires, cheques) and apply them accurately to customer accounts in NetSuite
  • Issue final invoices for standard customer accounts and review/process credit memos and billing adjustments with proper approvals
  • Manage customer record updates in NetSuite

Credit Control & Collections:

  • Take direct ownership of chasing overdue accounts via calls, emails, and structured collection cycles
  • Review the AR Aging report weekly to track overdue accounts, identify delinquent trends, and prioritise high-value collection efforts
  • Escalate severely overdue or high-risk accounts to Finance/Sales Management and Legal/Collections where necessary
  • Assess and assign credit limits for new and existing accounts based on payment history and financial reviews

Experience Required

  • 5+ years of dedicated Accounts Receivable or Finance experience
  • Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or comparable ERPs) and intermediate to advanced Excel
  •  

    Experience managing key enterprise client accounts, including submitting and tracking invoices via customer supplier portals (e.g. Coupa, SAP Ariba, Tungsten Network), purchase order-led invoicing and resolving rejected or queried invoices, is a strong advantage

  • Solid understanding of month-end AR reconciliations
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and cross-functional communication

Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them. Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet. You will build the foundation that fixes this. What you'll do Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it. Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production. Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team. Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent. Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io. Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today. Treat the warehouse like a product. Keep documentation, lineage, and discoverability current so departments trust the data assets, and handle sensitive HR and workforce data to GDPR standards. What success looks like in your first 3–6 months The warehouse has a real foundation. The first vertical slice, our accounts model, ships with tests and monitoring. You fully own the Dataform transform layer, creating capacity for semantic modeling and business-definition work Pipelines run against a defined freshness SLA, and you catch breaks before stakeholders do. Documentation and lineage cover what you own, and datasets that were stuck now flow to the teams that need them. What we're looking for You have built warehouse foundations yourself. You designed them rather than maintaining someone else's, with a track record in: Designing layered warehouse architectures (medallion, bronze-silver-gold) and dimensional models (star and snowflake) that teams reuse Advanced SQL as your daily working language Hands-on BigQuery, since our stack is GCP Building a SQL transform layer in Dataform, or strong dbt experience. ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads and real orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management Data quality, testing, freshness monitoring, and lineage built in from the start Python for pipeline code, scripting, automation, and API integration Reviewable, repeatable change through Git and PR-based deployment Nice to have, not required: another modern cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Redshift; managed ingestion such as Airbyte; preparing data for ML, LLM, and agentic use cases; and familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics and HR or workforce data. English is our working language, and Dutch is not required. This role isn't infrastructure engineering, ML or MLOps, or dashboard analysis. The Platform team owns infrastructure, the Product ML team owns ML, and the business teams own dashboards. It also isn't for someone who has only maintained a warehouse another person designed. You build the foundation properly, stay transparent about data quality and trade-offs, and treat the warehouse as a product for the whole company. description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft intelligenter Prozessautomatisierung Du bist ein erfahrener Softwareentwickler, denkst gerne über einzelne Features hinaus und hast Lust, mit KI, Automatisierung und modernen Technologien echte Probleme zu lösen? Du möchtest nicht nur Anforderungen umsetzen, sondern selbst technische Lösungen gestalten und deine Erfahrung in ein interdisziplinäres Team einbringen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Deine Rolle bei uns In unserem Team Elbe arbeiten Menschen mit unterschiedlichen fachlichen und technischen Hintergründen gemeinsam daran, Geschäftsprozesse intelligenter, effizienter und zunehmend automatisiert zu gestalten. Wir entwickeln Automatisierungen, verbinden bestehende Systeme, erschließen neue Einsatzmöglichkeiten für künstliche Intelligenz und schaffen Lösungen, die unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie unseren Kunden die tägliche Arbeit erleichtern. Dabei setzen wir auf einen pragmatischen Mix aus Low-Code-/No-Code-Plattformen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen und klassischer Softwareentwicklung. Als erfahrener Full-Stack Developer bringst du die technische Expertise mit, um unser Team auf das nächste Level zu heben. Du entwickelst selbst, übernimmst Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt deine Teamkollegen dabei, technisch immer eigenständiger zu werden. Das erwartet dich Softwareentwicklung und Architektur: Du konzipierst und entwickelst eigenständig Anwendungen, Services, APIs und Integrationen – vom technischen Entwurf bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Intelligente Prozessautomatisierung: Du entwickelst bestehende Automatisierungen weiter und setzt neue Lösungen um, beispielsweise mit n8n, APIs und individuell entwickelten Komponenten. KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du integrierst KI-Modelle in bestehende Prozesse, entwickelst KI-gestützte Anwendungen und experimentierst mit neuen Technologien und Werkzeugen. Systeme miteinander verbinden: Du sorgst dafür, dass unterschiedliche Plattformen und Anwendungen zuverlässig miteinander kommunizieren und Daten sicher ausgetauscht werden. Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Du triffst fundierte Architekturentscheidungen und achtest auf Wartbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und Qualität. Wissen teilen und gemeinsam wachsen: Du unterstützt deine Kollegen bei technischen Herausforderungen, führst sie an professionelle Entwicklungspraktiken heran und etablierst gemeinsam mit ihnen nachhaltige Lösungen. Eigenständig Lösungen schaffen: Du reduzierst technische Abhängigkeiten zu anderen Entwicklungsteams, indem du notwendige Komponenten selbst entwickelst und bestehende Schnittstellen sinnvoll nutzt. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Full-Stack-Umfeld. Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner Softwarearchitekturen. Erfahrung mit Backend-Technologien, APIs, Datenbanken und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme. Kenntnisse in modernen Frontend-Technologien und die Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig umzusetzen. Erfahrung mit Softwarequalität, Testing, Versionsverwaltung, CI/CD und dem Betrieb produktiver Anwendungen. Interesse an KI-Technologien, LLMs, AI-assisted Development und Automatisierungsplattformen. Die Fähigkeit, technische Herausforderungen pragmatisch zu lösen und dabei auch langfristige Anforderungen im Blick zu behalten. Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben, andere zu befähigen und gemeinsam technische Lösungen zu entwickeln. Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Einstellung: Du musst nicht jedes Framework kennen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du dich schnell in neue Technologien einarbeiten kannst, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Freude daran hast, in einem Team mit unterschiedlichen Kompetenzprofilen zu arbeiten. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und reichen von kleinen Automatisierungen bis zu komplexeren technischen Lösungen. Damit beschäftigst du dich beispielsweise: Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen und Datenverarbeitung, beispielsweise rund um Vermittler- und Vertragsdaten. Entwicklung und Erweiterung von Schnittstellen zwischen unserer Maklerplattform Professional Works und externen Anwendungen. KI-gestützte Verarbeitung und Auswertung von Gesprächstranskripten, einschließlich automatisierter Zusammenfassungen und Coaching-Ansätzen. Integration von Kommunikations-, Support- und Marketingplattformen in automatisierte Workflows. Entwicklung interner Werkzeuge für Reporting, Datenanalyse und operative Prozesse. Technische Weiterentwicklung und Stabilisierung unserer Automatisierungslandschaft.. Dabei entscheidest du gemeinsam mit dem Team, wann eine bestehende Automatisierungsplattform die beste Lösung ist und wann individuell entwickelte Software den größeren Mehrwert bietet. Warum diese Rolle besonders ist Bei uns erwartet dich kein klassisches Entwicklungsteam, in dem ausschließlich Softwareentwickler sitzen und Tickets abarbeiten. Du arbeitest mit Kollegen zusammen, die Geschäftsprozesse verstehen, Automatisierungen entwickeln, KI-Werkzeuge einsetzen und neue Ideen schnell ausprobieren. Du ergänzt dieses Team um fundierte Softwareentwicklungs- und Architekturkompetenz. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich deshalb nicht nur an dem Code, den du selbst schreibst, sondern auch daran, wie viel leistungsfähiger und eigenständiger das gesamte Team durch deine Arbeit wird. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Technologien mitzugestalten, neue Ansätze auszuprobieren und unmittelbar zu erleben, welchen Unterschied deine Lösungen im Unternehmen machen. description: Wil jij als Senior Implementatie Consultant meer end to end verantwoordelijkheden krijgen? Bij Whitevision geven we je meer autonomie en ruimte om processen bij de klant en binnen het team te verbeteren. Jouw rol Als Senior Implementatie Consultant word je verantwoordelijk voor meerdere implementaties bij verschillende organisaties, met een diversiteit aan Whitevision producten. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en de trusted advisor voor jouw klanten. Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf, in overleg met de klant, waar je je werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je analyseert klantprocessen, denkt strategisch mee over de beste inrichting en begeleidt organisaties servicegericht naar een succesvolle livegang. Je werkt zelfstandig, deelt je kennis met het team en coacht startende consultants. Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en draagt bij aan standaardisatie en verbetering van onze consultancyprocessen, die het team als geheel beter maken bijvoorbeeld door het inzetten van AI gedreven functionaliteit. Tegelijk blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen: je vergroot je productkennis, houdt je vakkennis bij en krijgt de ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidinggevende, coachende of expertrol binnen onze consultancyorganisatie. Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn: + Je leidt end to end de implementatietrajecten. + Je analyseert documentprocessen en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen. + Je adviseert klanten op operationeel én managementniveau. + Je traint eindgebruikers en zorgt voor maximale adoptie van onze software. + Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid binnen je projecten. + Je coacht junior en medior consultants en deelt actief je kennis. Wat breng je mee? + Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie. + Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties. + Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement. + Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels). + Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust. + Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré. + Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen. + Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur). Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren. Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken. Wat bieden wij? Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou: + Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring. + Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling. + 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur). + Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden. + Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie. + Een professioneel en hardwerkend team, waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan. + Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf Over Whitevision Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen. Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig. Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen. Doorgroeimogelijkheden Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie. Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. Learn more at verve.com.

What we're looking for:

We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Manager, HR Process Excellence to drive the design, optimisation and continuous improvement of HR processes across Verve Group. 

As the subject matter expert (SME) for HR process excellence, you will partner with HR leadership and leaders across the organisation. You will be identifying opportunities to improve the effectiveness of HR processes across the employee lifecycle. Key principles are simplicity and scalability as we embark on the next exciting stage of growth.

This is a temp-to-perm role offering a hybrid working arrangement, with three days per week in our London office in Covent Garden.

What you’ll be doing:

HR Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Act as the organisation's subject matter expert for HR process excellence, providing specialist guidance and thought leadership across a broad range of HR initiatives.
  • Lead the end-to-end assessment, design, redesign and optimisation of HR processes across the employee lifecycle.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate inefficiencies, reduce complexity, remove duplication and improve process effectiveness, quality and user experience.
  • Challenge legacy processes and existing ways of working, driving a culture of simplification and scalability.

Delivery of HR Improvement Initiatives

  • Lead and support multiple process improvement initiatives across HR, working across a portfolio of priorities that may include recruitment, onboarding, employee lifecycle management, HR operations, performance management, talent, reward and employee offboarding.
  • Develop business cases, quantify benefits and define measurable success criteria for proposed improvements.
  • Oversee implementation of agreed process changes, ensuring solutions are practical, scalable and simple!  

Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnering

  • Build strong relationships across the business. 
  • Act as a trusted adviser to senior stakeholders, providing expert recommendations on process design and improvement opportunities.
  • Balance commercial impact with legal risk and bring together internal stakeholders to align on a path forward. 

HR Technology, Data & Automation

  • Partner with HR Ops and Intelligence teams to identify opportunities for automation, workflow optimisation, self-service and improved use of HR systems.
  • Ensure process improvements are designed with technology enablement and automation at their core. 
  • Promote data-driven decision-making and the use of digital solutions to improve HR service across the entire employee experience.

Change Management & Capability Building

  • Support the adoption of redesigned processes through effective stakeholder engagement, communications, training and change management.
  • Equip HR teams and process owners with the tools, frameworks and knowledge required to sustain improvements independently.
  • Share best practices, lessons learned and reusable process improvement approaches across HR.
  • Champion a continuous improvement mindset, encouraging teams to challenge existing practices and take ownership of operational effectiveness.

What you'll need:

Essential Experience

  • Significant experience in HR process improvement, change management/transformation. Ideally a consultancy background, either internal or external. 
  • Demonstrable experience leading end-to-end process improvement initiatives within a global, rapidly growing organisation. 
  • Strong understanding of HR processes across multiple areas of the employee lifecycle. 
  • Experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously, from initial assessment and solution design through to implementation and benefits realisation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the credibility to engage and challenge senior leaders.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead change, influence adoption and embed sustainable improvements across teams.
  • Strong knowledge of process excellence methodologies this could include but not limited to Lean, Six Sigma, value stream mapping, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret operational data, establish baselines and measure improvement outcomes.
  • Understanding of HR technology, workflow automation, digital self-service and the role of technology in enabling process transformation.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
 
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Role

CoreWeave is taking its AI cloud and data center services to new countries. Each new market brings its own data protection, cybersecurity, and data residency requirements, and we have to meet them before we launch.

As the Technical Program Manager for International Security & Privacy Compliance, you will own the program that gets CoreWeave compliant in each new market. You will turn local legal and regulatory requirements into controls, timelines, and owners. Then you will lead Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Center Operations, Product, and Go-to-Market through to a compliant launch. The problem is defined; the solution is not. You will build the playbook as you go and make it repeatable for each market that follows.

The role is based in London so you can work during business hours with US teams and with teams in the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end compliance program for new-country launches, from early regulatory assessment through go-live and ongoing upkeep.
  • Work with Legal and Privacy counsel to turn local laws into concrete technical and operational requirements. These cover data protection and privacy, cybersecurity, data localization and residency, cross-border data transfer, incident reporting, and registration or licensing. Legal owns the interpretation; you own turning it into delivery.
  • Map country requirements to CoreWeave's existing control framework (SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, and related certifications). Find gaps and drive the work to close them with control owners in Security, Engineering, and Data Center Operations.
  • Build and maintain source-of-truth program plans, a requirements register, and a dependency map for each market. Use them to drive high-quality execution against timelines leadership can rely on.
  • Build country-specific incident and breach notification obligations into CoreWeave's incident response process before go-live.
  • Find risks and blockers early, such as data residency limits on architecture, local vendor or partner obligations, and regulator timelines. Drive them to resolution across teams, or escalate them with clear options and tradeoffs.
  • Coordinate privacy reviews and data protection impact assessments for in-country services, working with Privacy and Product.
  • Bring compliance requirements into product and data center launch plans early, so customer-facing commitments, contracts, and Trust Center content reflect what we can actually deliver.
  • Report program status, risk, and decisions needed to Security, Legal, and business leadership.
  • Make the work repeatable. Turn each market's lessons into a scalable country-entry playbook, templates, and workflows in Jira and our GRC tooling.

Who You Are

  • [5+] years of relevant experience in international security and privacy compliance program management, GRC, or related technical program management, preferably at a cloud, data center, or infrastructure provider.
  • A track record of managing end-to-end, large-scale, cross-functional programs with significant organizational impact under little or no supervision. You are comfortable with work that has a defined problem but no defined solution.
  • Strong execution skills. You get things done to high quality on timelines people can trust.
  • You identify risks and blockers early and drive them to resolution.
  • A solid grounding in industry best practices and frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, SOC 2, NIST CSF, and GDPR-style data protection regimes. You can make well-reasoned decisions and tradeoffs that fit CoreWeave's context.
  • You quickly learn and keep up with the requirements of unfamiliar jurisdictions, well enough to take an active part in decisions with Legal, Security, and Engineering.
  • You use feedback to shape priorities, and you make sure compliance solutions don't degrade the customer experience.
  • You influence cross-functional decisions with a structured approach, data, and technical insight, to achieve the intended outcome. You also contribute to the wider CoreWeave community, for example by mentoring others.
  • You win buy-in from critical stakeholders on your recommendations, define clear communication strategies tailored to the audience, from engineers to executives, and seek out feedback to improve how you work.

Preferred

  • Experience running compliance programs across several countries, especially in Asia-Pacific or the Middle East.
  • Experience with data residency, sovereign cloud, or in-country hosting requirements for cloud or data center services.
  • Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CISSP, CISM, CISA, or PMP.
  • Experience with GRC platforms and with Jira-based program tracking.

Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds, even if you don't check every box. Here are a few qualities we've found make someone successful on our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

  • You're comfortable balancing compliance rigor with practical, scalable solutions.
  • You take ownership, bring structure to ambiguity, and follow issues through to resolution.
  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and build strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • You're energized by building processes and systems that improve how teams work.

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

Personal Buying experience

Senior UX Researcher

Job description

 

In a nutshell

  • Senior UX Researcher (IC3)
  • Internal
  • Location: Lille
  • Timing: ASAP

 

Context & project

Decathlon’s mission is to bring people together through sport and make wellbeing accessible for all. To make this mission a reality, Decathlon relies on In-Store teammates who embody the human touchpoint between our brand and our customers, and are key enablers of Store business. This is exactly where your mission comes in: unlocking a deep understanding of our in-store teammates to identify key pain points and turn them into clear business opportunities. Working in a dynamic omnichannel context, you will partner closely with product teams to guide the creation of simple, efficient, and field-adapted experiences—enabling our teammates to be as impactful as possible with our customers while bridging the gap between user needs, business goals, and technological opportunities.

Digital plays a pivotal role in the quality of the connection built during moments shared between customers and teammates. How? By ensuring every In-Store Decathlonian works in an efficient and adapted environment that seamlessly supports their daily tasks.

 

Your mission

In this context, we’re looking for a UX Researcher to dive into In-Store behaviors and elevate the Personal Buying Experience. Your mission will be to uncover the needs and friction points of our teammates on the floor, identify and build strong opportunities, while supporting our product team in their craft.

As a User Researcher, you will enrich our User Knowledge and drive the tangible impact of your findings on our in-store tools. You will:

  • Decode the field: Conduct in-store observations to map the real-world practices, workflows, and pain points of our store teammates.
  • Guide decision-making: Turn qualitative and quantitative data into actionable strategic insights to shape the product roadmap.
  • Promote a User-first culture: Feed our team's knowledge repository to align Designers, Product Managers, and Tech leads with the reality on the shop floor.

 

Role & responsibilities

As a Senior Product Designer / Researcher, you will act as a key partner with cross-functional product teams to

  • influence and enlighten decisions, whether long-term strategy, quarterly roadmaps or day-to-day tactics
  • build a shared understanding / empathy of the current customer experiences
  • ensure that we identify and tackle the most relevant opportunities
  • build long-term impact (outcomes) rather than features (outputs)
  • build and feed a long term user and customer knowledge strategy

 

Craft / Core skills

  • Strategy & Framing - Support product decisions (product outcomes, opportunities, solutions) through research insights and Opportunity Solution Trees (OSTs) / Identify and prioritize research plans with stakeholders
  • Research / Problem Discovery - Uncover and refine opportunities through qualitative and/or quantitative research / Map end-to-end journeys & opportunity spaces / Make your findings easily accessible and understandable to your stakeholders (readouts, documentation, etc.) / Support teams to setup continuous discovery “habits” (eg. regular & holistic insights gathering, insights library, etc.)
  • Solution Discovery & Testing - Support designers & product trios by actively contributing to design critiques & test sessions / Provide research methodology guidance when needed
  • Inclusivity & Ethics - Craft research methodologies & outputs that fully include the diversity of our users and tackle possible biases

 

Behaviors / Soft skills

  • Influence - Work closely and proactively with all expertises (product, business, engineering, countries, etc.) to influence strategies, prioritization and discovery/delivery roadmaps
  • Cross-functional collaboration (functional management) - Involve your product teams and stakeholders throughout your research/design process, leveraging the right methods and/or storytelling, creating a safe environment for feedbacks
  • Design collaboration - Contribute to elevate the research practices, run and/or participate to collaborative design sessions with your peers across multiple teams (New Business Models, eCommerce, InStore, …)
  • Growth mindset - Proactively identify and build on your strengths and improvement areas, turn failures into positive learning lessons (for you and for others)

 

Behaviors / Soft skills

  • Influence - Work closely and proactively with all expertises (product, business, engineering, etc.) to influence strategies, prioritization and discovery/delivery roadmaps
  • Cross-functional collaboration - Involve your product team and stakeholders throughout your design process, leveraging the right methods and/or storytelling, creating a safe environment for feedbacks
  • Design collaboration - Contribute to elevate the design practice, run and/or participate to collaborative design sessions (co-design, design critiques) with your peers across multiple teams (New Business Models, eCommerce, …)
  • Growth mindset - Proactively identify and build on your strengths and improvement areas, turn failures into positive learning lessons (for you and for others)



Why join the In-Store adventure?

Here are a few challenges you may tackle if you join the In-Store adventure

  • Enhance the human bound - Simplifying complexity and leveraging store teams and management, building more and more quality time spaces between our customer and our teammate
  • Improve Store efficiency - Empower our teammates on the field, understand their pain-points and provide strong, efficient and scalable solutions
  • Reinforce the end-to-end, omni experience - Contribute to an high & amazing end-to-end experience for our customer, by designing the best digital experience for our teammates
  • Design the store of tomorrow - Leverage on digital to support the store evolution, and design the futur of our actual main touchpoint with the customer.

 

In-Store might be a perfect match for you if…

  • You want to support the teammates, and be at the heart of Decathlon's ecosystem
  • You love collaborating with a wide variety of expertises & stakeholders (your product team, but also people from eCom, Business, Countries, Sports, etc.)
  • You want to be part of a lovely & united team, always ready to help each other or share good laughs
  • You want to play a key role in transforming Decathlon’s stores !

 

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Flexible working: 2 days of remote work per week;
  • Work locations: Ability to work from any Decathlon Digital office in Lille, Paris, or Nantes;
  • High-quality gear: Equipment provided in line with your mission and our social commitments (Mac, Windows, or Chromebooks);
  • Global reach: A local project team within a worldwide network (offering international career opportunities);
  • Skill development: Continuous growth and support (diverse projects, technical certifications from year one, internal and external training, etc.);
  • Compensation package: Competitive package (employee profit-sharing, monthly/quarterly bonuses).

 

DECATHLON DIGITAL CONTEXT

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

  • Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

  • Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

  • Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

  • Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

  • Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

  • Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

  • Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

  • Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

  • Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

  • Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

  • Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

  • Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

  • Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

  • Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

  • Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

  • CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

  • Open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, KServe, or related projects.

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description: Stage Software Development Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: Python; C++; Rust; Angular; Typescript; Playwright; Zabbix; Linux; MariaDB; Kubernetes; SALT. Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten? Studio for e-mail Door de aanhoudende groei van het aantal IXON Cloud-gebruikers neemt de diversiteit aan specifieke wensen toe. Om dit te realiseren, wordt een intuïtieve e-mailstudio ontwikkeld waarmee de gebruiker eenvoudig en naar eigen inzicht berichten kan opstellen en beheren. description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for an experienced, driven Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Switzerland's largest enterprises. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Swiss brands and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology. In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies. In this role you will: Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Switzerland to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for consumer and retail brands. Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to Swiss consumer and retail organizations operating at scale. Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants. Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Swiss consumer and retail sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures. Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents. Requirements 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms. Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement. Well-connected in the Swiss consumer and retail landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level. Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value. Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Switzerland, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures. Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly. Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers. A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale. Swiss German is the preferred default language for this role; fluency in both Swiss German and French is a strong plus given Switzerland's multilingual market. Strong English is also required for internal collaboration. Location This is an in-country role based in Zurich. description:
As Studio Director, you will lead the end-to-end operation of Suitsupply's photo studio, ensuring the efficient delivery of high-quality visual assets across every customer touchpoint. You will drive operational excellence through process optimization, resource planning, and technology enablement, partnering closely with Creative, Brand, Merchandising, Marketing, E-Commerce, and Production teams. This role calls for a strong operational mindset, balancing quality, speed, cost, and capacity while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and increase productivity. You will own the studio's technology roadmap, including AI-driven solutions, and lead a cross-functional network of photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers. Your leadership will directly shape the scalability, efficiency, and creative output of one of Suitsupply's core content production functions. 
What You Will Do 
  • Lead day-to-day studio operations — managing capacity, resource allocation, schedules, and workload planning — and ensure output is delivered on time, on budget, and to quality standards. 
  • Coordinate photographers, stylists, retouchers, and producers, and establish KPIs and reporting to track throughput, turnaround, utilization, and quality. 
  • Own and continuously improve end-to-end studio workflows, using production data and bottleneck analysis to eliminate inefficiencies and drive scalable ways of working. 
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize technologies for production planning, asset management, and workflow automation, leveraging AI to accelerate content production and improve quality control. 
  • Build business cases for technology investments and drive adoption across the studio team, partnering with Technology and Digital teams. 
  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for studio matters across Creative, Brand, Marketing, Merchandising, Retail, E-commerce, and Production teams. 
  • Manage external partners — retouching, production, equipment, and technology vendors — negotiating contracts and rates to ensure cost-effective, high-quality service. 
  • Own the studio operating budget across external retouching, tooling, technology, equipment, and resources, monitoring productivity, utilization, and costs to optimize spend. 
  • Support strategic planning and future studio capability development. 
Who You Are 
  • 10+ years in studio operations, content production, or related operational leadership, with proven experience managing high-volume production in fashion, retail, e-commerce, or a comparable industry. 
  • Strong operational and analytical mindset, using data and metrics to improve workflows, simplify processes, and drive efficiency. 
  • Experience implementing new technologies, workflow management systems, and AI-enabled solutions; hands-on with platforms such as Creative Force, Photoshop, and Figma. 
  • Strong project, stakeholder, and resource management skills across competing priorities and deadlines. 
  • Commercially minded, with experience managing budgets, vendors, and operational performance. 
  • Self-directed, pragmatic, and solution-oriented, with strong ownership and accountability. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Photography, Creative Production, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. 
What You Will Get 
  • Autonomy: We empower you to take ownership, make meaningful decisions, and drive impact without layers of sign-off. 
  • Growth: We see your potential as a key asset. At Suitsupply, you'll have abundant opportunities to learn, grow, and excel in a supportive environment that encourages development at every step. 
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization. 
  • Style: Immerse yourself in a world of beautifully crafted, high-quality products, and enjoy a 40% discount on Suitsupply products.
  • Compensation: We offer a competitive salary of based on relevant skills and experience.

With over 45,000 professionals dedicated to Data & AI, Accenture's Data & AI organization brings together Experienced Innovation, Strategic Investment, Exceptional Talent, and a Power Ecosystem to deliver outcomes at the frontier of what is possible. About the Role The Full Stack AI Consultant (Developer) is a hands-on engineer at the core of Accenture's agentic AI delivery capability. This role is for those who build things — full stack applications, agentic workflows, knowledge pipelines, and tool integrations — and who want to do that work at the frontier of enterprise AI. Consultants work within delivery teams, turning business requirements into production-grade agentic AI solutions under the guidance of technical leads and managers. The expectation is active, daily engineering: writing code, building agents, implementing MCP servers, designing knowledge pipelines, and maintaining the DevOps and AgentOps practices that keep production systems running. Consultants on this team are also expected to invest continuously in learning — agentic AI is evolving rapidly, and staying current is a professional responsibility, not optional. Position Responsibilities Full Stack Application Development Design and build full stack agentic AI applications — Python backends, REST and event-driven APIs, and React or equivalent frontends — to production engineering standards. Implement agentic application UX: streaming responses, intermediate output display, reasoning transparency, and error and escalation interfaces for end users. Translate business requirements into technical specifications; work with managers and clients to clarify scope, surface ambiguities, and deliver against agreed outcomes. Agentic AI Development Build and configure agents using established orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent): harness setup, persona and instruction loading, tool binding, memory configuration, and lifecycle management. Implement reasoning patterns (ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute) appropriate to each agent use case; design and version prompt architecture including system prompts, few-shot examples, and structured output schemas. Build multi-agent workflows — defining agent roles, A2A handoff contracts, shared state schemas, and escalation paths — under architectural guidance from technical leads. MCP, Tools, Skills, and Workflows Design, build, and maintain MCP servers connecting agents to enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms — with robust schema design, error handling, idempotency, and retry logic. Translate business processes into agent-executable skills, structured instructions, and reusable workflows — bridging the gap between business requirements and agent implementation. Implement context engineering pipelines, memory architectures (episodic, working, long-term), and LLM gateway configuration to support reliable, cost-efficient agent operation. Knowledge Layer Implementation Build RAG pipelines: document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector store indexing, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, and quality evaluation. Implement Text-to-SQL capabilities — schema grounding, query generation, validation, and safe execution against enterprise databases. Integrate Elasticsearch as a retrieval backend; build knowledge graph components and ontology-driven query layers where required by the use case.
